generic.Defined scope/population: Every renewal class and segment covered by the coming cycle strategy, in-appetite and no-write alike.
generic.In-scope period: The coming renewal cycle from strategy effective date through the last expiry month it governs.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each segment carries an appetite position, premium target, policy count target and rate direction.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Planned renewal premium and policy count reconcile to the portfolio plan within agreed tolerance.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Strategy pack stored in the underwriting workstation with version number and CUO sign-off date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Classes outside the signed Risk Appetite Statement are logged with an exit or exception disposition.
generic.Test population: All renewal segments named in the approved renewal strategy for the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any segment target has no link to the current signed Risk Appetite Statement version.
generic.Exception handling path: Unaligned segments return to the Portfolio UW Manager and are re-tabled at the next CUO review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when appetite alignment, premium plan tie-out and CUO sign-off are all evidenced.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal strategy pack in the underwriting workstation with the Power BI portfolio plan extract.

steps.title: Pull the current signed Risk Appetite Statement version in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the appetite library in the underwriting workstation and select the latest signed version.
Note the version number and effective date for citation in the strategy.
List each class marked in-appetite, restricted, or no-write for the cycle.
Done when the signed appetite version and its class list are captured.
verify: Check the version cited is the latest signed one, not a draft.
Pass when the appetite version number and effective date are recorded on the strategy.

steps.title: Build the renewal portfolio baseline in Power BI
sop: Open the Power BI renewal portfolio report and filter to the coming cycle expiry months.
Extract in-force premium, policy count and loss ratio by class and segment.
Record the data-as-of date shown on the report.
Done when the baseline premium and count by segment are exported.
verify: Reconcile the exported premium and count to the in-force register total.
Pass when the baseline ties to in-force within the agreed tolerance.

steps.title: Set the appetite position per renewal segment in the strategy document
sop: Map every renewal segment in the baseline to an appetite position from the signed statement.
Mark classes moving to no-write for the coming cycle explicitly.
Record the driver for each position change in one line per segment.
Done when no segment is left without a stated appetite position.
verify: Scan the segment list for blank or ambiguous appetite positions.
Pass when every segment carries an in-appetite, restricted or no-write label.

steps.title: Set renewal premium and policy count targets against the portfolio plan
sop: Enter planned renewal premium and policy count per segment in the strategy pack.
Compare the segment totals to the approved portfolio plan figures.
Adjust or annotate any segment outside the agreed variance tolerance.
Done when planned totals reconcile to the portfolio plan within tolerance.
verify: Recompute the segment totals and compare to the portfolio plan control total.
Pass when the reconciliation variance sits inside the agreed tolerance.

steps.title: Define run-off timelines and notice lead time for exit classes
sop: List each class being exited and its earliest and latest expiry dates in the cycle.
Set a run-off timeline and the notice lead time needed for the longest statutory period.
Flag any exit class where lead time is already too short to serve notice.
Done when every exit class carries a run-off timeline and notice lead time.
verify: Check each exit class row for a populated run-off date and lead time.
Pass when no exit class is missing a stated run-off timeline.

steps.title: Obtain CUO sign-off and publish the strategy in the underwriting workstation
sop: Review the strategy against the signed appetite statement and the portfolio plan.
Record the approval decision, approver name and approval date on the strategy pack.
Publish the approved version to the underwriting workstation for the renewal teams.
Done when the approved strategy is published with sign-off recorded.
verify: Confirm approved-by and approval date are populated for the current renewal cycle.
Pass when accounts are released to underwriters only after the sign-off date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All renewal accounts expiring in the assignment window that need an underwriter owner.
generic.In-scope period: Renewals expiring within the next 90 days plus the current assignment month.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every renewal record carries Assigned To, assignment date and the assignee authority band.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assigned account count and premium reconcile to the renewal book listing for the window.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assignment run saved in the underwriting workstation with the run date and allocator name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Accounts above the assignee authority are logged and routed to the senior underwriter queue.
generic.Test population: All renewals with an expiry date inside the next 90 days.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any renewal expiring within 90 days has a blank Assigned To value.
generic.Exception handling path: Over-authority or over-capacity assignments are reworked by the Underwriting Director before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when every in-window renewal has an owner inside authority and within workload bands.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal workqueue assignment view in the underwriting workstation and the Power BI workload report.

steps.title: Extract the unassigned renewal workqueue from the underwriting workstation
sop: Filter the renewal workqueue to expiries in the next 90 days.
Isolate records with a blank or lapsed Assigned To value.
Record the count and total premium of the unassigned population.
Done when the unassigned renewal list is produced with counts.
verify: Compare the extracted count to the renewal book listing for the same window.
Pass when the extract reconciles to the book listing count.

steps.title: Load current underwriter capacity from the Power BI workload report
sop: Open the Power BI workload report for the renewal team.
Read open account count and premium in hand per underwriter for the month.
Note underwriters already at or above the agreed workload band.
Done when current capacity per underwriter is recorded.
verify: Check the report data-as-of date is the current working day.
Pass when capacity figures come from a same-day refresh.

steps.title: Match each renewal premium and limit to the assignee authority band
sop: Read the authority matrix band for each candidate underwriter.
Compare each account premium and limit to that band before assigning.
Assign only where the account sits inside the assignee band.
Done when every proposed assignment sits inside the assignee authority band.
verify: Sample assignments and re-test premium and limit against the authority matrix.
Pass when no assigned account exceeds the assignee authority band.

steps.title: Route over-authority accounts to the senior underwriter queue
sop: Isolate accounts whose premium or limit exceeds every available assignee band.
Move those accounts to the senior underwriter queue in the workstation.
Record the routing reason on each account.
Done when no over-authority account sits in a standard underwriter queue.
verify: Re-run the over-authority filter on the assigned population.
Pass when the over-authority queue holds every flagged account.

steps.title: Balance workload per underwriter against the agreed account and premium band
sop: Recalculate account count and premium per underwriter after provisional assignment.
Reallocate accounts where an underwriter breaches the agreed monthly band.
Record any deliberate overload with the reason and review date.
Done when each underwriter sits inside the agreed workload band or is logged as an exception.
verify: Recheck the per-underwriter totals in the Power BI workload report.
Pass when every underwriter is inside band or carries a logged exception.

steps.title: Commit assignments and stamp the assignment date in the workqueue
sop: Write the Assigned To value and assignment date to each renewal record.
Confirm the 90-day review clock starts from the stamped assignment date.
Notify assignees through the workqueue that accounts have been released.
Done when all in-window renewals carry an owner and an assignment date.
verify: Re-run the blank Assigned To filter over the 90-day window.
Pass when no renewal expiring within 90 days has a blank Assigned To value.

generic.Defined scope/population: Each renewal account being assessed for prior-year underwriting performance and loss development.
generic.In-scope period: The expiring term plus the three prior terms of loss experience for the account.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Incurred loss ratio, valuation date, open claim reserves and large-loss flags are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claim counts and incurred amounts reconcile between ClaimCenter and the Power BI loss report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Loss analysis saved to the renewal file with the claims valuation date and extract timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Accounts breaching the large-loss or large-account threshold are logged for actuarial review.
generic.Test population: All renewal accounts in the underwriter assessment queue for the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if loss ratio is recorded without a valuation date or excludes open claim development.
generic.Exception handling path: Accounts above the large-account threshold route to actuarial review before tiering.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when four-term loss ratios with development are recorded and compared to class target.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal file in the underwriting workstation with the Power BI loss extract and ClaimCenter reference.

steps.title: Extract four-term incurred loss experience from Guidewire ClaimCenter
sop: Search ClaimCenter by policy for claims in the expiring and three prior terms.
Export incurred amounts including case reserves and recoveries.
Record the claims valuation date shown on the extract.
Done when four terms of incurred loss data are extracted with a valuation date.
verify: Reconcile the extracted claim count and incurred total to the Power BI loss report.
Pass when both sources agree within rounding on incurred and count.

steps.title: Calculate incurred loss ratio by term in Power BI
sop: Load earned premium by term alongside the incurred loss data.
Calculate the incurred loss ratio for the expiring term and each prior term.
Record the calculation basis and valuation date beside each ratio.
Done when four loss ratios are calculated on a consistent basis.
verify: Recompute one term ratio by hand from premium and incurred figures.
Pass when the recomputed ratio matches the reported ratio.

steps.title: Add IBNR and case development to open claims in the analysis
sop: Identify open claims in the expiring term and their current case reserves.
Apply the agreed development or IBNR loading rather than using paid losses only.
Note which claims drive the development uplift.
Done when the loss ratio reflects open claim development, not paid only.
verify: Check the analysis for a stated development or IBNR component.
Pass when the recorded loss ratio includes open claim development.

steps.title: Flag single claims above the large-loss threshold in the underwriting workstation
sop: Compare each claim incurred amount to the large-loss threshold for the class.
Flag every breaching claim on the renewal file record.
Note whether the cause of loss is expected to recur.
Done when every large loss is flagged with a recurrence assessment.
verify: Re-run the threshold test over the extracted claim list.
Pass when no claim above the threshold is left unflagged.

steps.title: Compare the account loss ratio to class and portfolio targets in Power BI
sop: Read the class and portfolio target loss ratio from the Power BI benchmark view.
Compare the account developed loss ratio to both targets.
Record the variance and the resulting performance conclusion.
Done when the account is positioned against class and portfolio targets.
verify: Check the benchmark figures cited match the current published targets.
Pass when the comparison uses current class and portfolio targets.

steps.title: Trigger actuarial review for large accounts and file the analysis
sop: Test account premium against the large-account threshold for actuarial review.
Raise the actuarial review request where the threshold is breached.
Attach the loss analysis and valuation date to the renewal file.
Done when the analysis is filed and any required actuarial review is raised.
verify: Confirm the filed analysis shows loss ratio, valuation date and open-claim development.
Pass when the renewal file carries the dated loss analysis for every assessed account.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every renewal account in the cycle book that must be tiered retain, re-rate or exit.
generic.In-scope period: The renewal cycle expiry window covered by the approved renewal strategy.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each account carries a tier value, tiering rule reference and rate floor where re-rated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Tiered account count and premium reconcile to the renewal book listing totals.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Tiering run saved in the underwriting workstation with run date and strategy version reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Tier overrides are logged with requester, reason and director approval decision.
generic.Test population: All renewal accounts in the cycle renewal book listing.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any renewal account is left without a retain, re-rate or exit tier.
generic.Exception handling path: Override requests route to the Underwriting Director for approval before accounts are released.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when every account is tiered by rule, exits have notice lead time and overrides are approved.
generic.Evidence location: Tiering view in the underwriting workstation with the Power BI tier distribution report.

steps.title: Load the renewal book and tiering rules into Power BI
sop: Open the Power BI renewal tiering report for the cycle expiry window.
Load loss ratio, rate adequacy and appetite position for every account.
Confirm the documented tiering rule set and its version.
Done when the book and the current tiering rules are loaded.
verify: Compare the loaded account count to the renewal book listing total.
Pass when the loaded population matches the book listing count.

steps.title: Apply the documented tiering rules to assign retain, re-rate or exit
sop: Run the tiering rules across the loaded renewal population.
Assign each account a retain, re-rate or exit tier from the rule outcome.
Record the rule reference that produced each tier.
Done when every account carries a rule-derived tier.
verify: Filter for accounts with a blank tier value.
Pass when no renewal account is left without a tier.

steps.title: Force no-write and exited-class accounts into the exit tier
sop: Cross-check the tiered book against the no-write list and exited classes.
Move any such account into the exit tier regardless of the rule outcome.
Record the appetite reference driving the forced exit.
Done when no no-write or exited-class account sits outside the exit tier.
verify: Re-run the no-write cross-check over the tiered population.
Pass when every no-write account is in the exit tier.

steps.title: Set the rate-change floor on every re-rate account in the underwriting workstation
sop: Read the required rate-change floor for the segment from the renewal strategy.
Write the floor to each account tagged re-rate in the workstation.
Raise account-specific floors where loss experience demands more.
Done when every re-rate account carries a rate-change floor.
verify: Filter re-rate accounts for a blank rate-change floor.
Pass when no re-rate account is missing a floor value.

steps.title: Test exit-tier accounts for sufficient statutory notice lead time
sop: Calculate days to expiry for each exit-tier account.
Compare the days remaining to the longest applicable non-renewal notice period.
Escalate accounts where the notice window has already closed.
Done when every exit account is confirmed to have or lack notice lead time.
verify: Recheck the shortest-dated exit accounts against the notice requirement.
Pass when no exit account is progressed with an expired notice window.

steps.title: Route tier overrides to the Underwriting Director and release the tiered book
sop: Review each requested override against the tiering rules and appetite.
Record the approval or rejection with reason and date on the account.
Release the tiered book to underwriters once overrides are cleared.
Done when the tiered book is released with all overrides decided.
verify: Confirm no override remains undecided on the released book.
Pass when the released book has a tier on every account and no open override.

generic.Defined scope/population: Producing brokers and agents for renewal accounts requiring a strategy conversation this cycle.
generic.In-scope period: From 90 days before expiry through the date terms are presented.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Conversation date, attendees, rate direction conveyed and outcome are recorded on the account.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Strategic accounts with a logged broker contact reconcile to the strategic account list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Contact note stored on the broker and account record with date and channel.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Accounts where early engagement was missed are logged with the reason and a catch-up date.
generic.Test population: All strategic renewal accounts due for early engagement in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a strategic account has no broker renewal-strategy contact logged with date and outcome.
generic.Exception handling path: Missed or late engagements escalate to the Underwriting Director for a recovery plan.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the conversation is held 90 days out and the outcome is logged on the account.
generic.Evidence location: Account activity record in the underwriting workstation with the Teams or email trail.

steps.title: Identify strategic accounts due for early engagement in the underwriting workstation
sop: Filter the assigned renewal book to accounts meeting the strategic definition.
Calculate days to expiry and select accounts approaching the 90-day mark.
Confirm the producing broker contact on each account is current.
Done when the early-engagement call list is produced.
verify: Check each listed account against the strategic account definition.
Pass when the list contains only accounts meeting the definition.

steps.title: Prepare the engagement brief from the approved renewal strategy
sop: Read the account tier, rate direction and any contemplated coverage changes.
Note which decisions are approved and which are still pending approval.
Draft the talking points covering rate direction and data requirements.
Done when the brief separates approved messages from pending decisions.
verify: Review the brief for any account-level appetite decision still awaiting approval.
Pass when no pending decision appears in the material to be shared.

steps.title: Hold the early-engagement conversation at least 90 days before expiry
sop: Schedule the call or meeting through Microsoft Teams or email at least 90 days out.
State the expected rate-change direction and any contemplated coverage changes.
Record attendees on both sides during the conversation.
Done when the conversation is held before the 90-day threshold.
verify: Compare the meeting date to the policy expiry date.
Pass when the conversation date is at least 90 days before expiry.

steps.title: Confirm the renewal submission data requirements and due date with the broker
sop: List the updated exposure data and loss runs required for the renewal.
Agree the date by which the broker will return the submission.
Send the requirement list through the Broker & Agent Portal.
Done when the broker acknowledges the data list and due date.
verify: Check the portal for the broker acknowledgement against the requirement list.
Pass when a dated broker acknowledgement is on file.

steps.title: Log the conversation date, attendees and outcome on the account record
sop: Write the contact note on the account in the underwriting workstation.
Record date, channel, attendees, rate direction conveyed and broker reaction.
Link the note to the broker record as well as the account.
Done when the contact note is saved against account and broker.
verify: Open the account activity record and read back the logged contact.
Pass when the broker renewal-strategy contact is recorded with date and outcome.

steps.title: Escalate missed or resistant engagements to the Underwriting Director
sop: Review accounts where engagement was missed or the broker pushed back hard.
Agree a recovery plan or a revised negotiating position.
Record the escalation decision and date on the account.
Done when every missed or escalated account carries a decision.
verify: Re-run the early-engagement gap list after escalation.
Pass when every strategic account has a logged contact or a logged escalation.

generic.Defined scope/population: All renewal segments in the book that need a rate-change range and a technical pricing floor.
generic.In-scope period: The renewal cycle from the pricing strategy effective date to its next scheduled review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each segment carries a rate-change range, renewal floor and the actuarial indication reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Segments configured in Earnix reconcile to the segment list in the approved pricing strategy.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Pricing strategy published in Earnix with version number and effective date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Segments priced outside the actuarial indication are logged with rationale and approval.
generic.Test population: Every renewal segment configured in the Earnix renewal pricing model.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any segment lacks an effective-dated rate-change band or a renewal floor.
generic.Exception handling path: Below-floor pricing is blocked in Earnix and routed to mandatory referral.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when bands and floors are filed-rate compliant, versioned and effective dated in Earnix.
generic.Evidence location: Earnix renewal pricing configuration with the Power BI indication pack behind it.

steps.title: Load the current actuarial rate indication into Power BI for review
sop: Open the current actuarial rate indication pack for the renewal book.
Read the indicated rate need by segment and the trend assumption used.
Record the indication document reference and its date.
Done when the indication by segment is loaded with its reference.
verify: Check the indication version is the latest issued, not a superseded pack.
Pass when the loaded indication is the current published version.

steps.title: Set the renewal rate-change range by segment in Earnix
sop: Enter the minimum and maximum renewal rate change for each segment.
Derive the range from the indication rather than from last cycle bands.
Note the rationale where the band deviates from the indication.
Done when every segment carries a rate-change range in Earnix.
verify: Filter the Earnix segment table for blank rate-change bands.
Pass when no segment is missing a rate-change range.

steps.title: Define the minimum acceptable technical price as the renewal floor
sop: Calculate the technical price floor per segment from the indication and expense loads.
Configure the floor in Earnix so pricing below it triggers mandatory referral.
Document how the floor was derived for each segment.
Done when a renewal floor is configured for every segment.
verify: Test a sample quote priced below the floor in Earnix.
Pass when the below-floor quote raises a mandatory referral.

steps.title: Confirm the strategy uses only filed and approved rating factors
sop: List every rating factor and adjustment used in the renewal pricing approach.
Check each factor against the filed and approved rate structure for the state.
Remove or replace any factor that is not filed and approved.
Done when only filed and approved factors remain in the strategy.
verify: Re-check the factor list against the filing record.
Pass when no unfiled rating factor is used in the renewal approach.

steps.title: Test the approach for adverse treatment of existing customers
sop: Compare renewal pricing outcomes to equivalent new-business pricing by segment.
Identify any segment where renewals are systematically priced higher on the same risk.
Adjust the approach or record the objective justification for the difference.
Done when no unjustified renewal-versus-new-business gap remains.
verify: Re-run the renewal versus new-business comparison after adjustment.
Pass when no segment shows an unjustified price disadvantage for existing customers.

steps.title: Publish the pricing strategy version and effective date in Earnix
sop: Approve the final bands, floors and factor set for the cycle.
Publish the configuration with a version number and effective date in Earnix.
Notify underwriting that the new renewal pricing basis is live.
Done when the versioned strategy is live in Earnix.
verify: Open the Earnix configuration and read back version and effective date.
Pass when effective-dated rate-change bands and the renewal floor are configured.

generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force policies with expiry dates falling in the reporting window for the renewal book.
generic.In-scope period: The expiry window covered by the listing run, stated as a from and to expiry date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, insured, expiry date, premium band and strategic priority flag are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Extracted policy count and premium reconcile to the in-force register for the same window.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Listing saved with run date, source system and extract timestamp on the report header.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Policies excluded as non-renewed or cancelled are listed separately with the exclusion reason.
generic.Test population: All policies extracted from the policy administration system for the expiry window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the extract does not reconcile to the in-force register within the agreed tolerance.
generic.Exception handling path: Unreconciled differences route to the Portfolio UW Manager before the listing is distributed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the listing is segmented, reconciled and shows the run date on distribution.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal book listing in Power BI with the supporting Excel extract and reconciliation tab.

steps.title: Extract expiring policies from the policy administration system
sop: Set the expiry date range for the reporting window in the extract parameters.
Run the in-force policy extract from the policy administration system.
Capture the run date and record count on the extract header.
Done when the expiring policy extract is produced with a run date.
verify: Check the extract expiry range matches the requested reporting window.
Pass when the extract covers exactly the requested window.

steps.title: Reconcile extracted count and premium to the in-force register
sop: Compare extracted policy count and premium to the in-force register totals.
Investigate any difference beyond the agreed tolerance.
Record the reconciliation on a dedicated tab in Microsoft Excel.
Done when the extract reconciles to in-force within tolerance.
verify: Re-add the reconciliation tab totals against the register.
Pass when the reconciliation difference is inside tolerance.

steps.title: Exclude non-renewed and cancelled policies from the listing
sop: Filter out policies already flagged non-renewed or cancelled.
Move excluded rows to a separate tab with the exclusion reason.
Restate the listing totals after exclusions.
Done when only live renewable policies remain in the main listing.
verify: Search the main listing for any cancelled or non-renewed status.
Pass when no excluded status appears in the main listing.

steps.title: Segment the listing by expiry month, premium band and priority flag
sop: Add expiry month and premium band columns to the extract in Excel.
Join the strategic priority flag from the account record.
Build the segmented pivot for distribution.
Done when every row carries expiry month, premium band and priority flag.
verify: Filter for rows with a blank segment value.
Pass when no row is missing a segmentation value.

steps.title: Publish the segmented listing to the Power BI renewal book report
sop: Load the segmented listing into the Power BI renewal book dataset.
Confirm the report shows the run date and reconciliation totals.
Check the segment breakdowns render for each expiry month.
Done when the Power BI listing reflects the current run.
verify: Open the published report and read the run date and totals.
Pass when run date and in-force reconciliation totals are displayed.

steps.title: Distribute the listing to underwriting management
sop: Review the segmented listing and reconciliation before release.
Distribute the listing link to underwriting management with the run date stated.
Record the distribution date on the report log.
Done when management has the reconciled listing with its run date.
verify: Confirm the distributed version is the reconciled run, not a draft.
Pass when the distributed listing carries the run date and reconciled totals.

generic.Defined scope/population: Renewal accounts in the assigned book that meet any referral or approval trigger.
generic.In-scope period: The current renewal cycle up to the point quoting begins on each account.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each flagged account carries a referral trigger code, approval level and routing date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Flagged account count reconciles between the workstation queue and the Power BI referral report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Referral flag stamped on the account with the date and the underwriter who raised it.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Accounts de-flagged after review are logged with the reviewer and the reason.
generic.Test population: All renewal accounts in the assigned book for the current cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any account flagged for approval has no referral trigger code recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Mis-routed referrals are returned to the Renewal Underwriter for correct level routing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when every trigger-meeting account is flagged, coded and routed before quoting.
generic.Evidence location: Referral queue in the underwriting workstation and the Power BI referral trigger report.

steps.title: Test each renewal against the authority band in the underwriting workstation
sop: Read the handling underwriter authority band from the authority matrix.
Compare account premium and limit to that band for every assigned renewal.
Flag accounts exceeding the band for approval.
Done when all over-authority accounts are flagged.
verify: Re-test a sample of unflagged accounts against the authority band.
Pass when no over-authority account remains unflagged.

steps.title: Flag classes requiring appetite exception or CUO approval
sop: Cross-check each account class against the restricted and exception class lists.
Flag accounts in classes requiring appetite exception or CUO approval.
Record the appetite reference that drives the flag.
Done when all restricted-class accounts are flagged.
verify: Re-run the restricted-class cross-check on the book.
Pass when every restricted-class renewal carries a flag.

steps.title: Flag accounts whose required rate change exceeds delegated deviation
sop: Compare each account required rate change to the delegated deviation allowance.
Flag accounts where the required change exceeds the allowance.
Note the size of the deviation on the flag.
Done when all deviation breaches are flagged with their size.
verify: Recompute the deviation on a sample of flagged accounts.
Pass when the recorded deviation matches the recalculated figure.

steps.title: Attach the specific referral trigger code to each flagged account
sop: Select the trigger code that matches the reason for each flag.
Write the code to the account referral field in the workstation.
Where several triggers apply, record the highest-authority trigger.
Done when every flagged account carries a trigger code.
verify: Filter flagged accounts for a blank trigger code.
Pass when a referral trigger code is recorded on every flagged account.

steps.title: Route flagged accounts to the correct approval level before quoting
sop: Map each trigger code to the required approval level.
Move each flagged account to that approver queue in the workstation.
Confirm quoting is blocked on the account until approval is recorded.
Done when every flagged account sits in the correct approver queue.
verify: Check flagged accounts for any quote issued before routing.
Pass when no flagged account was quoted before it was routed.

steps.title: Reconcile the flagged population in the Power BI referral report
sop: Open the Power BI referral trigger report for the cycle.
Compare flagged counts by trigger code to the workstation queue.
Investigate and correct any difference.
Done when both sources agree on the flagged population.
verify: Re-run the comparison after correction.
Pass when the workstation queue and referral report counts agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: All renewal segments tracked for retention rate and rate change against plan targets.
generic.In-scope period: Cycle to date from the start of the renewal cycle to the current data-as-of date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Retention by count, retention by premium, achieved rate change and variance reason are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Retained plus lost policy counts reconcile to the expired renewal population for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Tracker refreshed at the agreed cadence with the data-as-of date shown on the report.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Segments below the retention tolerance are logged with the escalation and owner.
generic.Test population: All renewals that reached their expiry date within the cycle-to-date window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if retention or achieved rate change is shown without a data-as-of date.
generic.Exception handling path: Segments beyond tolerance escalate to the Underwriting Director with a corrective action.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when retention and rate change are shown against plan with variance split by cause.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI renewal retention dashboard sourced from the underwriting workstation outcomes.

steps.title: Refresh the retention dataset in Power BI at the agreed cadence
sop: Trigger the scheduled refresh of the renewal outcomes dataset.
Confirm the data-as-of date advances to the current period.
Check the refresh completed without row rejections.
Done when the dashboard shows the current data-as-of date.
verify: Read the data-as-of stamp on the published dashboard.
Pass when the stamp matches the agreed refresh cadence.

steps.title: Report retention rate by policy count and by premium against targets
sop: Calculate retention by policy count and by premium for each segment.
Place both measures beside the segment retention target.
Highlight segments below target.
Done when both retention measures are shown against target by segment.
verify: Reconcile retained plus lost counts to the expired renewal population.
Pass when the counts reconcile for the reporting period.

steps.title: Report achieved renewal rate change against the planned target
sop: Calculate achieved rate change on bound renewals by segment.
Compare it to the planned rate-change target from the pricing strategy.
Record the gap in basis points per segment.
Done when achieved rate change sits beside plan for every segment.
verify: Recompute achieved rate change for one segment from the underlying accounts.
Pass when the recomputed figure matches the dashboard value.

steps.title: Split retention variance by cause in the underwriting workstation outcomes
sop: Group lost renewals by loss reason code from the workstation outcome field.
Split the variance into lost-to-competitor, insured-cancelled and insurer non-renewed.
Show the split alongside the retention gap per segment.
Done when every lost renewal falls into one of the three causes.
verify: Check for lost renewals with an unmapped or blank cause.
Pass when every lost renewal carries a mapped cause.

steps.title: Escalate segments beyond the retention tolerance
sop: Identify segments more than the agreed tolerance below target.
Raise the escalation with the cause split and the affected premium.
Agree and record a corrective action and owner.
Done when every breaching segment has an escalation and an owner.
verify: Re-run the tolerance test after escalations are logged.
Pass when no breaching segment is left without a logged escalation.

steps.title: Publish the tracker with the data-as-of date to underwriting management
sop: Confirm retention, rate change and variance views are complete.
Publish the dashboard link to underwriting management.
Record the publication date in the reporting log.
Done when management has the current tracker.
verify: Open the published tracker as a recipient.
Pass when retention rate and achieved rate change show against plan with the data-as-of date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All renewal segments plus loss-affected and under-priced accounts needing rate-change targets.
generic.In-scope period: The renewal cycle governed by the current actuarial indication and trend assumption.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each target carries a value, a segment or account key and the source indication reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Targets loaded into Earnix reconcile to the approved target schedule row for row.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Targets loaded in Earnix with version, effective date and the indication document reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Targets set outside the indication are logged with justification and management approval.
generic.Test population: All renewal segments and flagged accounts in the approved target schedule.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any segment target has no source actuarial indication reference recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Targets exceeding the filed rate structure are withdrawn and referred for a rate filing decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when targets are indication-backed, filing-compliant and visible on the renewal worksheet.
generic.Evidence location: Earnix renewal target configuration with the Power BI indication and target comparison view.

steps.title: Read the current actuarial indication and trend assumption in Power BI
sop: Open the current indication pack in the Power BI actuarial view.
Record the indicated rate need and trend assumption per segment.
Capture the indication document reference and date.
Done when indication and trend are captured for every segment.
verify: Check the indication reference is the current published version.
Pass when the captured indication matches the latest published pack.

steps.title: Set the segment rate-change target from the indication
sop: Derive each segment target from the indicated need and trend.
Record any deliberate departure from the indication with a reason.
Assemble the segment target schedule for approval.
Done when every segment carries a derived target.
verify: Filter the schedule for blank segment targets.
Pass when no segment is missing a rate-change target.

steps.title: Set account-level targets for loss-affected and under-priced accounts
sop: Identify accounts with loss ratios or rate adequacy outside the segment norm.
Set an account-level target above the segment target for each.
Record the loss or adequacy evidence behind each account target.
Done when every flagged account carries its own target.
verify: Sample account targets and re-test against the loss and adequacy data.
Pass when each account target is supported by the recorded evidence.

steps.title: Test targets against what the filed rate structure permits
sop: Compare each target to the maximum change achievable under the filed rates.
Flag targets that would need a new rate filing to achieve.
Withdraw or re-scope those targets pending a filing decision.
Done when no target exceeds the filed rate structure without a filing decision.
verify: Re-check flagged targets against the filing position.
Pass when no unachievable target remains in the approved schedule.

steps.title: Record the indication reference and date behind each target
sop: Attach the indication document reference to every segment and account target.
Record the indication date beside the reference.
Store the schedule with references for audit.
Done when every target carries its source reference and date.
verify: Filter the target schedule for missing indication references.
Pass when segment targets are present with the source actuarial indication reference.

steps.title: Load approved targets into Earnix so they show on the renewal worksheet
sop: Load the approved target schedule into the Earnix renewal configuration.
Confirm the targets surface on the renewal worksheet for underwriters.
Record the load version and effective date.
Done when approved targets are live on the renewal worksheet.
verify: Open a sample renewal worksheet in Earnix and read the displayed target.
Pass when the worksheet target matches the approved schedule value.

generic.Defined scope/population: The renewal exposure base for the account being rated at current filed rate level.
generic.In-scope period: The renewal policy term from the renewal effective date to the renewal expiry date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Exposure values, class codes, experience modification and schedule credits are populated and in range.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Rated exposure totals reconcile to the exposure schedule supplied by the broker.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rating worksheet saved to the renewal file with tool version and rate effective date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rates below class minimum premium are logged and corrected or referred before quoting.
generic.Test population: All rating lines produced for the renewal account in Earnix.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the rate table version applied is not the currently filed version for the state.
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-range credits or debits are returned to the underwriter for correction or referral.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the rated premium is produced on filed rates and stamped with the rate effective date.
generic.Evidence location: Earnix rating worksheet attached to the renewal file in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Load the updated exposure base into the Earnix rating worksheet
sop: Enter values, payroll, revenue and unit counts from the broker exposure schedule.
Confirm class codes and locations match the schedule supplied.
Save the worksheet against the renewal account.
Done when the full exposure base is loaded in the worksheet.
verify: Reconcile the worksheet exposure totals to the broker schedule.
Pass when worksheet and schedule totals agree.

steps.title: Select the currently filed rate table version for the state in Earnix
sop: Read the state and effective date on the renewal.
Select the filed rate table version effective at the renewal effective date.
Record the table version and its effective date.
Done when the filed rate version is applied to the worksheet.
verify: Compare the applied rate version to the filing record for the state.
Pass when the applied version is the currently filed and effective one.

steps.title: Apply experience modification and schedule credits within permitted ranges
sop: Enter the current experience modification from the rating bureau or internal calculation.
Apply schedule credits and debits inside the permitted filed range.
Record the justification for each credit or debit.
Done when all modifiers are applied inside permitted ranges.
verify: Re-test each applied modifier against the permitted range.
Pass when no modifier sits outside the filed permitted range.

steps.title: Produce the rated premium and test against class minimum premium
sop: Run the rating calculation in Earnix to produce the renewal premium.
Compare the rated premium to the class and state minimum premium.
Correct or refer where the premium falls below minimum.
Done when the rated premium clears the applicable minimum premium.
verify: Re-read the minimum premium rule for the class and state.
Pass when the rated premium is at or above the minimum.

steps.title: Push the rated premium into Guidewire PolicyCenter for the renewal term
sop: Transfer the rated premium and exposure detail to the PolicyCenter renewal transaction.
Confirm the premium in PolicyCenter matches the Earnix output.
Resolve any transfer variance before proceeding.
Done when PolicyCenter holds the rated premium unchanged.
verify: Compare the PolicyCenter premium to the Earnix rated premium.
Pass when the two figures match exactly.

steps.title: Save the stamped rating worksheet to the renewal file in the workstation
sop: Save the worksheet with tool version, rate table version and rate effective date.
Attach the worksheet to the renewal file in the underwriting workstation.
Note the exposure source document reference on the file.
Done when the stamped worksheet is attached to the renewal file.
verify: Open the attached worksheet and read the stamps.
Pass when the filed rate table version and effective date are stamped on the rated premium.

generic.Defined scope/population: The rated renewal premium and the restated expiring premium for the account under comparison.
generic.In-scope period: The expiring term including mid-term endorsements, compared to the renewal term.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rate change, exposure change, restated expiring premium and target comparison are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Rate change plus exposure change reconcile to the total premium variance.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Premium comparison worksheet attached to the renewal file with the calculation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Shortfalls against the account rate-change target are logged with the underwriter explanation.
generic.Test population: All renewal accounts reaching the premium comparison stage in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if rate change is not separated from exposure change on the comparison.
generic.Exception handling path: Premium decreases against a worsening loss ratio route to the Senior Underwriter for review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the variance is decomposed, expiring is restated and the worksheet is filed.
generic.Evidence location: Premium comparison worksheet on the renewal file with the Earnix and Power BI extracts.

steps.title: Restate the expiring premium for mid-term endorsements in the workstation
sop: List all mid-term endorsements on the expiring term and their premium effect.
Annualise the expiring premium including endorsement adjustments.
Record the restated expiring premium on the worksheet.
Done when the expiring premium is restated on a full-term basis.
verify: Re-add endorsement premium effects to the original expiring premium.
Pass when the restated figure matches the recalculation.

steps.title: Calculate total premium variance against the rated renewal premium
sop: Compare the Earnix rated renewal premium to the restated expiring premium.
Record the variance in amount and percentage.
Note the currency and term basis used.
Done when the total premium variance is calculated.
verify: Recompute the variance from the two premium figures.
Pass when the recomputed variance matches the worksheet.

steps.title: Separate pure rate change from exposure change in Earnix
sop: Re-rate the expiring exposure at renewal rates to isolate pure rate change.
Attribute the remaining variance to exposure movement.
Show rate change and exposure change as separate lines.
Done when the variance is split into rate and exposure components.
verify: Check that rate change plus exposure change equals total variance.
Pass when the components reconcile to the total variance.

steps.title: Compare achieved rate change to the account target in Power BI
sop: Read the account rate-change target from the Power BI target view.
Compare the achieved pure rate change to that target.
Flag the account where the achieved change falls short.
Done when the achieved-versus-target position is recorded.
verify: Re-read the target value from the approved target schedule.
Pass when the comparison uses the current approved target.

steps.title: Explain any premium decrease against a deteriorating loss ratio
sop: Identify accounts with a premium decrease and a worsening loss ratio.
Require a written file note explaining the technical basis for the decrease.
Refer the account onward where the explanation is inadequate.
Done when every such account carries an explanation or a referral.
verify: Search the population for unexplained decreases on deteriorating accounts.
Pass when no such account lacks an explanation or referral.

steps.title: Attach the premium comparison worksheet to the renewal file
sop: Finalise the worksheet with restated expiring, rate change and exposure change.
Attach it to the renewal file in the underwriting workstation.
Record the calculation date and preparer.
Done when the worksheet is attached and dated.
verify: Open the attached worksheet from the renewal file.
Pass when rate change is separated from exposure change and expiring is restated.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every proposed coverage change on the renewal, covering limits, deductibles, sublimits and exclusions.
generic.In-scope period: The renewal term from renewal effective date, with notice periods running before it.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each change carries a form or endorsement number, filed status and a driving reason.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Forms listed on the renewal reconcile to the forms schedule held in PolicyCenter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Coverage change list saved on the renewal file with form version numbers and decision date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Coverage reductions requiring referral are logged with the referral outcome.
generic.Test population: All forms and endorsements proposed for attachment to the renewal.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any superseded or unfiled form version is attached to the renewal.
generic.Exception handling path: Unfiled or superseded forms are replaced with the filed version before terms are offered.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when every change is filed-compliant, evidence-linked and referred where required.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal forms schedule in Guidewire PolicyCenter with the decision note in the workstation.

steps.title: List each proposed coverage change on the renewal file
sop: List proposed changes to limit, deductible or retention, sublimit and exclusions.
State the current position and the proposed position for each.
Record the change list on the renewal file in the workstation.
Done when every proposed change is listed with before and after positions.
verify: Compare the change list to the expiring policy terms.
Pass when every difference from expiring appears on the list.

steps.title: Tie each restriction to the loss experience or survey finding that drives it
sop: Link each coverage restriction to the specific claim, survey or exposure finding.
Attach the supporting evidence reference to the change line.
Remove restrictions that have no evidential basis.
Done when every restriction carries an evidence reference.
verify: Sample restrictions and open the linked evidence.
Pass when each restriction resolves to a real loss or survey finding.

steps.title: Validate every form and endorsement version in Guidewire PolicyCenter
sop: Look up each form and endorsement in the PolicyCenter forms library.
Confirm the version is currently filed and approved for the risk state.
Replace any superseded or unfiled version with the filed one.
Done when every attached form is a filed and current version.
verify: Re-check the renewal forms schedule against the filed forms list.
Pass when no superseded or unfiled form version is attached to the renewal.

steps.title: Check advance notice requirements for coverage reductions
sop: Identify changes that reduce coverage or increase the insured retention.
Check the policy wording and state rules for advance notice requirements.
Calculate the latest date the change can be advised for the renewal date.
Done when notice requirements and deadlines are recorded per change.
verify: Compare the planned advice date to the calculated notice deadline.
Pass when every reduction can still be advised inside its notice window.

steps.title: Flag coverage reductions requiring referral before they are offered
sop: Test each reduction against the referral triggers in the authority matrix.
Flag reductions that need approval before being offered to the broker.
Hold the change out of the quote until the referral is decided.
Done when every referral-triggering reduction is flagged and held.
verify: Check whether any flagged reduction reached the broker before approval.
Pass when no flagged reduction was offered before referral approval.

steps.title: Record the final coverage change decision on the renewal file
sop: Review the change list, evidence links, form versions and referral outcomes.
Record the approved final coverage position with the decision date.
Release the approved change set to the quote preparation step.
Done when the approved coverage change set is recorded and released.
verify: Compare the released change set to the forms schedule in PolicyCenter.
Pass when the released set and the PolicyCenter schedule agree.

generic.Defined scope/population: The renewal decision, rate change applied and supporting reasoning for the account.
generic.In-scope period: From the renewal decision date through the 24-hour file note deadline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Decision, rate change, loss and exposure basis, appetite position and approval reference are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Rate change stated in the note matches the rate change on the premium comparison worksheet.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: File note stored in the workstation and OpenText with author, timestamp and edit lock.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Deviations from the segment rate-change target are recorded with the acceptance reason.
generic.Test population: All renewal accounts with a decision recorded in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the rationale note is undated or not authored by the deciding underwriter.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing or late notes are chased by the underwriter and escalated if unresolved.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when a dated, locked note explains decision, rate change and any deviation.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal file note in the underwriting workstation with the copy indexed in OpenText.

steps.title: Open the renewal file note template in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the renewal account and start the rationale note against the current term.
Confirm the note is linked to the renewal transaction, not the expiring term.
Populate account, term and decision date fields.
Done when the note is opened against the correct renewal transaction.
verify: Check the note header shows the renewal term and decision date.
Pass when the note is bound to the correct renewal transaction.

steps.title: Record the renewal decision and the rate change applied
sop: State the decision to renew, re-rate or decline in plain terms.
Record the rate change applied as a percentage and an amount.
Cross-check the figure to the premium comparison worksheet.
Done when decision and rate change are stated in the note.
verify: Compare the noted rate change to the comparison worksheet figure.
Pass when the two figures agree.

steps.title: Reference the loss experience, exposure change and appetite position
sop: Cite the developed loss ratio and its valuation date.
Cite the exposure movement and the appetite conclusion for the class.
Link each citation to the source document in the file.
Done when all three supporting elements are cited with sources.
verify: Open each cited source from the note links.
Pass when every citation resolves to a document on the file.

steps.title: Record referral or authority approval references in the same note
sop: List every referral raised on the renewal and its outcome.
Record approver name, approval date and any conditions.
Include the approval reference number for each.
Done when all approvals are referenced in the note.
verify: Compare the referenced approvals to the workstation referral record.
Pass when every recorded referral appears in the note.

steps.title: Document any deviation from the segment rate-change target
sop: Compare the applied rate change to the segment target.
Where short, state why the lower change was accepted.
Reference the approval that permitted the deviation.
Done when every deviation is explained and approval-linked.
verify: Search the note for an unexplained shortfall against target.
Pass when no deviation is left without an explanation.

steps.title: Finalise, timestamp and index the note in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Confirm the note is completed within 24 hours of the decision.
Lock the note against edit in the workstation.
Index the copy to OpenText against the policy and renewal term.
Done when the note is locked and indexed with a timestamp.
verify: Check the note timestamp against the recorded decision date.
Pass when a dated renewal rationale note authored by the deciding underwriter is on file.

generic.Defined scope/population: Approved renewal quotes ready to be issued to the producing broker for the cycle.
generic.In-scope period: From quote approval to at least 60 days before the policy expiry date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Quote validity dates, coverage changes, subjectivities and issue date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Quoted premium on the issued document matches the approved premium in the workstation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued quote stored with version, issue date and delivery channel on the account.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Quotes issued inside 60 days are logged with the reason and management awareness.
generic.Test population: All renewal quotes issued to brokers in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the quote issue date is less than 60 days before the policy expiry date.
generic.Exception handling path: Late quotes escalate to the Renewal Underwriter for expedited broker engagement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the quote is issued 60 days out with changes, validity and subjectivities stated.
generic.Evidence location: Broker & Agent Portal delivery record with the quote copy on the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Confirm the quote is approved and ready to issue in the workstation
sop: Check all referrals on the renewal are approved and recorded.
Confirm the quote premium and terms match the approved position.
Confirm no coverage change is still pending approval.
Done when the quote is confirmed approved and complete.
verify: Compare quote terms to the recorded approval.
Pass when the quote matches the approved terms exactly.

steps.title: Set the quote validity period and expiry date on the document
sop: Set the validity period per the renewal quoting standard.
Print the validity expiry date clearly on the quote document.
Diarise the validity expiry in the workstation.
Done when the quote shows a validity period and expiry date.
verify: Read the validity dates on the generated document.
Pass when the validity period and its expiry date are stated.

steps.title: List all coverage changes and deductible changes explicitly on the quote
sop: Itemise every change from expiring terms on the quote face.
Show new exclusions and deductible movements as separate lines.
Avoid relying on the broker comparing documents to spot changes.
Done when every change from expiring appears explicitly on the quote.
verify: Compare the quote change list to the approved coverage change set.
Pass when the two lists match line for line.

steps.title: State subjectivities and their satisfaction dates on the quote
sop: List each subjectivity carried on the renewal quote.
State the date by which each must be satisfied.
Mark which subjectivities are conditions precedent to binding.
Done when every subjectivity carries a due date.
verify: Filter the subjectivity list for missing due dates.
Pass when no subjectivity is shown without a satisfaction date.

steps.title: Issue the quote to the broker at least 60 days before expiry
sop: Calculate days to expiry before pressing issue.
Deliver the quote through the Broker & Agent Portal and confirm by email.
Where inside 60 days, log the reason before issuing.
Done when the quote is delivered to the producing broker.
verify: Compare the issue date to the policy expiry date.
Pass when the quote issue date is at least 60 days prior to expiry.

steps.title: Log issue date and delivery channel on the account
sop: Record the issue date, channel and recipient on the account activity log.
Attach the issued quote version to the renewal file.
Diarise the broker follow-up date.
Done when issue date and channel are logged against the account.
verify: Open the account activity log and read the issue record.
Pass when the 60-day standard is evidenced by the logged issue date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Renewal terms that deviate from the expiring policy and therefore require referral approval.
generic.In-scope period: From identification of the deviation to the moment the quote is released to the broker.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Deviation type, deviation size, approver, approval date and conditions are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Referred deviation count matches the deviation list on the renewal comparison.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Referral record stored in the workstation with submission and decision timestamps.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Referrals declined or approved with conditions are logged with the conditions recorded.
generic.Test population: All renewals carrying at least one deviation from expiring terms.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a quote is released before the approval is recorded on the account.
generic.Exception handling path: Deviations beyond the approver authority escalate to the next authority level.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the largest deviation is approved at the correct level and recorded before release.
generic.Evidence location: Referral record on the renewal account in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Identify each renewal term deviating from expiring in the workstation
sop: Compare renewal limits, deductibles, forms and pricing to the expiring terms.
List each deviation and quantify its size.
Record the list on the renewal referral form.
Done when every deviation is listed with its size.
verify: Compare the deviation list to the premium and coverage comparison.
Pass when every identified difference is on the referral list.

steps.title: Determine the authority level covering the largest deviation
sop: Map each deviation to its authority requirement in the matrix.
Select the highest authority level required across all deviations.
Record why that level was chosen.
Done when the correct approval level is identified.
verify: Re-test the largest deviation against the authority matrix.
Pass when the referral targets the level covering the largest deviation.

steps.title: Attach the recommendation and pricing analysis to the referral
sop: Write the underwriter recommendation with the technical rationale.
Attach the rating worksheet and premium comparison.
Include the loss analysis supporting the position.
Done when the referral carries recommendation and supporting analysis.
verify: Open the referral and check the attachments are present and current.
Pass when recommendation and pricing analysis are both attached.

steps.title: Submit the referral and obtain the Senior Underwriter assessment
sop: Review the deviations, pricing and loss position on the referral.
Record support, challenge or rejection with reasons.
Pass the referral to the director level where required.
Done when the senior assessment is recorded on the referral.
verify: Read the recorded senior assessment on the referral.
Pass when a dated senior assessment is present before director decision.

steps.title: Record the approval decision, approver and conditions on the account
sop: Decide approve, approve with conditions or decline.
Record approver name, decision date and every condition attached.
Return declined referrals to the underwriter with required changes.
Done when the decision and conditions are recorded on the account.
verify: Open the account referral record and read the decision fields.
Pass when approver identity, approval date and conditions are recorded.

steps.title: Block quote release until approval is recorded
sop: Check the referral status before generating or sending the quote.
Hold delivery where the approval is not yet recorded.
Apply any approval conditions into the quote terms before issue.
Done when the quote is only released after approval is recorded.
verify: Compare quote issue timestamp to the approval timestamp.
Pass when no quote was released to the broker before the approval was recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Updated exposure and loss information required from the broker for the renewal submission.
generic.In-scope period: From 90 days before expiry until the renewal is marked ready to rate.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Values, payroll, revenue, unit schedules and loss run valuation dates are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Updated exposure schedule totals reconcile to the expiring schedule with variances explained.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Received documents indexed to the renewal file with receipt date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Outstanding mandatory items are logged as incomplete with a chase date.
generic.Test population: All renewals requiring a broker information request in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a renewal is marked ready to rate with mandatory exposure data outstanding.
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete submissions are chased and escalated to the Renewal Underwriter before rating.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the request is issued 90 days out and all mandatory data is received and indexed.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal submission folder in OpenText linked from the underwriting workstation file.

steps.title: Issue the renewal information request through the Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Generate the standard renewal information request for the account.
Issue it to the producing broker at least 90 days before expiry.
Record the issue date and the response due date.
Done when the request is issued inside the 90-day standard.
verify: Compare the request issue date to the expiry date.
Pass when the request went out at least 90 days before expiry.

steps.title: Specify the exposure data and loss runs required
sop: List updated values, payroll, revenue and vehicle or unit schedules required.
Request current loss runs for the required number of years.
State which items are mandatory before rating.
Done when the request itemises all mandatory data.
verify: Compare the itemised list to the class data requirement standard.
Pass when every mandatory item for the class is requested.

steps.title: Check the age of loss runs supplied against the acceptable window
sop: Read the valuation date on each supplied loss run.
Compare it to the acceptable age window for renewal underwriting.
Request a re-valued run where the data is stale.
Done when all loss runs sit inside the acceptable age window.
verify: Recheck valuation dates on the accepted loss runs.
Pass when no accepted loss run is older than the permitted window.

steps.title: Reconcile the updated exposure schedule to the expiring schedule
sop: Compare updated values, payroll and units line by line to expiring.
Identify material swings by location or class.
Query material movements with the broker and record the response.
Done when material exposure swings are explained.
verify: Recompute the schedule totals and the movement percentage.
Pass when every material swing carries a broker explanation.

steps.title: Index every received document to the renewal file in OpenText
sop: Index each received document against policy number and renewal term.
Record the receipt date and document type on each item.
Link the OpenText reference into the workstation renewal file.
Done when every received document is indexed and linked.
verify: Open the renewal file and count indexed documents against the receipt log.
Pass when every logged receipt has an indexed document.

steps.title: Mark the submission complete or incomplete before rating
sop: Check every mandatory item against the requirement list.
Set the submission status to complete only when nothing mandatory is missing.
Where incomplete, record the outstanding items and chase date.
Done when the submission status reflects the true data position.
verify: Filter renewals marked ready to rate for outstanding mandatory items.
Pass when no renewal is marked ready to rate with mandatory data outstanding.

generic.Defined scope/population: The drafted renewal quote for the account including premium, forms and subjectivities.
generic.In-scope period: The renewal term being quoted, from renewal effective date to renewal expiry.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Premium, limits, deductibles, forms schedule, credits with justification and charges are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Quote premium reconciles to the Earnix rated premium and the PolicyCenter transaction.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft quote saved with version number and preparation date on the renewal file.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Schedule credits or debits without written justification are logged and corrected.
generic.Test population: All schedule rating credits and debits applied on the renewal quote.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any schedule credit or debit has no written justification recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Unjustified or out-of-range modifiers are removed or referred before the quote is finalised.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the quote is built from rated premium with justified modifiers and correct charges.
generic.Evidence location: Draft quote in Guidewire PolicyCenter with the Earnix worksheet on the renewal file.

steps.title: Build the quote from the Earnix rated premium, not from expiring plus a factor
sop: Import the Earnix rated premium into the PolicyCenter quote.
Confirm no manual uplift is applied over the expiring premium.
Record the rating worksheet reference on the quote.
Done when the quote premium equals the rated premium.
verify: Compare the quote premium to the Earnix rated premium.
Pass when the two figures agree exactly.

steps.title: Attach the correct forms schedule including approved coverage changes
sop: Load the approved coverage change set into the quote forms schedule.
Confirm each form version is the filed and current one.
Remove forms retired at this renewal.
Done when the forms schedule matches the approved change set.
verify: Compare the quote forms schedule to the approved change set.
Pass when the schedule and the approved set agree.

steps.title: Document the justification for every schedule credit and debit
sop: List each schedule rating modifier applied on the quote.
Write the risk-based justification for each modifier.
Confirm each sits inside the filed permitted range.
Done when every modifier carries a written justification.
verify: Filter the modifier list for blank justifications.
Pass when written justification is recorded for each schedule credit or debit.

steps.title: Carry forward or retire subjectivities and warranties explicitly
sop: Review the expiring subjectivities and warranties.
Decide for each whether it carries forward or is retired.
State retirements explicitly on the quote rather than dropping silently.
Done when every expiring subjectivity has an explicit disposition.
verify: Compare the expiring and renewal subjectivity lists.
Pass when every expiring item is carried or explicitly retired.

steps.title: Check commission and statutory charges on the quote
sop: Confirm the commission rate matches the broker agreement.
Check terrorism and statutory charges are shown and calculated correctly.
Confirm taxes and fees follow the state requirements.
Done when all charges are shown correctly on the quote.
verify: Recompute the commission and statutory charges from the premium.
Pass when the quote figures match the recalculation.

steps.title: Save the drafted quote version to the renewal file
sop: Save the draft quote with a version number and preparation date.
Attach the Earnix worksheet and justification notes to the renewal file.
Set the quote status to ready for issue.
Done when the versioned draft quote is on the renewal file.
