Pass when the draft quote and its supporting worksheet are both filed.

generic.Defined scope/population: The renewal account re-underwritten against current appetite guidelines and refreshed data.
generic.In-scope period: Current guideline version at the renewal date with loss history to the latest valuation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Class code, operations, geography, sanctions result and appetite conclusion are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Entities screened match the named insured list held in the policy record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Appetite conclusion recorded with the guideline version and the screening date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Out-of-appetite conclusions are logged with the referral or exit disposition.
generic.Test population: All renewal accounts re-underwritten in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the appetite conclusion cites a superseded guideline version.
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-appetite accounts route to referral or to the non-renewal process.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the account is tested on the current guide with a recorded appetite conclusion.
generic.Evidence location: Re-underwriting note on the renewal file with LexisNexis and ClaimCenter references.

steps.title: Load the current appetite guide version in the underwriting workstation
sop: Open the appetite guide library and select the version current at renewal.
Confirm it is not the version in force at policy inception.
Record the guide version and effective date.
Done when the current guide version is loaded and recorded.
verify: Compare the loaded version to the published current version.
Pass when the current appetite guide version is the one referenced.

steps.title: Confirm class code, operations and geography are unchanged
sop: Compare the renewal class code and operations description to expiring.
Compare location and geography schedules to expiring.
Trigger a re-rate where any of these changed.
Done when changes are identified and re-rating is triggered where needed.
verify: Re-check the renewal against the expiring classification record.
Pass when any classification change has a corresponding re-rate action.

steps.title: Re-screen named insureds and new entities against sanctions lists
sop: List all named insureds and any entity added since inception.
Run the sanctions and watch-list screen for each in LexisNexis Risk.
Record the screening date and the result per entity.
Done when every entity is screened with a dated result.
verify: Compare screened entities to the named insured list on the policy.
Pass when every named entity has a dated screening result.

steps.title: Refresh third-party risk data and record permissible purpose
sop: Refresh the third-party risk attributes used in the assessment.
Record the permissible purpose before pulling any consumer report.
Store the report reference and pull date on the file.
Done when refreshed data is on file with permissible purpose recorded.
verify: Check each consumer report pull for a recorded permissible purpose.
Pass when no report was pulled without a recorded purpose.

steps.title: Re-test loss history in Guidewire ClaimCenter against guideline thresholds
sop: Pull the updated loss history including open claim development.
Compare frequency and severity to the guideline acceptance thresholds.
Note every threshold breach.
Done when the loss position is tested against current thresholds.
verify: Recompute one threshold test from the claim data.
Pass when the recorded breaches match the recalculation.

steps.title: Record the in or out-of-appetite conclusion with the guideline reference
sop: Review the classification, screening, data refresh and loss tests.
Record the in or out-of-appetite conclusion with the specific guideline clause.
Route out-of-appetite accounts to referral or non-renewal.
Done when the conclusion and guideline reference are recorded.
verify: Read back the conclusion and cited guideline version on the file.
Pass when the current guide version is referenced with an in or out-of-appetite conclusion.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims incurred during the expiring policy period for the renewal account under review.
generic.In-scope period: The expiring policy term from inception to expiry at the latest claims valuation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Incurred amounts, open reserves, recoveries, cause of loss and valuation date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claim counts and incurred totals reconcile between ClaimCenter and the Power BI loss view.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Loss review attached to the renewal file with the claims valuation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Large or reserve-volatile claims are logged with a development assessment.
generic.Test population: All claims with a date of loss inside the expiring policy term.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the incurred position excludes open reserves or omits the valuation date.
generic.Exception handling path: Volatile or disputed reserves are referred for a claims discussion before pricing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when incurred with reserves, drivers and the rate impact are filed with a valuation date.
generic.Evidence location: Loss review note on the renewal file with the ClaimCenter and Power BI extracts.

steps.title: Pull expiring-term claims from Guidewire ClaimCenter
sop: Search ClaimCenter for claims with a date of loss inside the expiring term.
Export incurred amounts, open reserves and recoveries.
Record the valuation date on the extract.
Done when the expiring-term claim set is extracted with a valuation date.
verify: Reconcile the extracted claim count to the Power BI loss view.
Pass when both sources report the same claim count.

steps.title: Identify frequency versus severity drivers in Power BI
sop: Group claims by cause of loss and count occurrences.
Compare claim frequency and average severity to class norms.
Note any repeat cause of loss across the term.
Done when the frequency and severity drivers are identified.
verify: Recount the largest cause-of-loss group from the extract.
Pass when the recount matches the reported grouping.

steps.title: Assess large and reserve-volatile claims for future development
sop: List claims above the large-loss threshold and those with volatile reserves.
Assess likely future development on each with the claims position.
Record the expected development range.
Done when each large or volatile claim has a development assessment.
verify: Re-check the flagged claims against the threshold and reserve movement.
Pass when every qualifying claim has an assessment.

steps.title: Quantify the loss-driven element of the required rate change
sop: Convert the developed loss position into an indicated rate need for the account.
Separate the loss-driven element from exposure and portfolio elements.
Record the loss-driven rate requirement.
Done when the loss-driven rate element is quantified.
verify: Recompute the loss-driven element from developed losses and premium.
Pass when the recomputed figure matches the recorded requirement.

steps.title: Confirm risk-control or corrective actions taken since the losses
sop: Request evidence of corrective action from the broker or survey record.
Record what has changed at the risk since each significant loss.
Note where no corrective action has been evidenced.
Done when corrective actions are recorded or their absence noted.
verify: Check each significant loss for a recorded corrective action position.
Pass when no significant loss is left without a recorded position.

steps.title: Attach the loss review with valuation date to the renewal file
sop: Finalise the review with incurred, reserves, drivers and rate impact.
Attach the review and the ClaimCenter extract to the renewal file.
Record the valuation date on the file note.
Done when the dated loss review is on the renewal file.
verify: Open the filed review and read the incurred and valuation fields.
Pass when the incurred position including open reserves and valuation date is attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: The broker counter-proposal terms for the renewal account being evaluated against the floor.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Counter terms, re-rated premium, floor comparison and accept or counter decision are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Re-rated counter premium reconciles to the Earnix output for the counter terms.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assessment saved on the renewal file with the re-rating date and Earnix worksheet version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Counters breaching delegated deviation authority are logged and referred.
generic.Test population: All broker counter-proposals received on renewal quotes in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a counter-proposal is assessed on headline premium without re-rating the terms.
generic.Exception handling path: Below-floor counters route to referral before any response is given to the broker.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the counter is re-rated, compared to the floor and an explicit decision is recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Counter-proposal assessment on the renewal file with the Earnix re-rating worksheet.

steps.title: Record the broker counter-proposal terms in the underwriting workstation
sop: Capture the counter premium, limits, deductibles and coverage requests.
Link the counter to the specific quote version it responds to.
Record the receipt date and broker contact.
Done when the counter terms are recorded against the quote version.
verify: Compare the recorded terms to the broker written counter.
Pass when the recorded terms match the broker document.

steps.title: Re-rate the counter-proposal terms in Earnix
sop: Enter the counter terms as a new rating scenario in Earnix.
Produce the technical premium for those terms.
Do not accept the broker headline premium as the technical answer.
Done when the counter terms carry a re-rated technical premium.
verify: Compare the Earnix scenario inputs to the counter terms.
Pass when the scenario reflects the counter terms exactly.

steps.title: Price requested coverage broadening or deductible reduction
sop: Identify each requested broadening or deductible reduction.
Price the exposure effect of each into the comparison.
Show the loaded premium impact per request.
Done when every coverage request is priced into the comparison.
verify: Check each request appears with a priced impact.
Pass when no coverage request is left unpriced.

steps.title: Compare the counter premium to the documented renewal floor
sop: Read the renewal floor for the segment from the pricing configuration.
Compare the loaded counter premium to that floor.
Record the gap in amount and percentage.
Done when the counter is positioned against the renewal floor.
verify: Re-read the floor value from the Earnix configuration.
Pass when the comparison uses the current published floor.

steps.title: Test whether accepting the counter breaches delegated deviation authority
sop: Compare the deviation implied by the counter to the delegated allowance.
Flag counters that would breach the allowance.
Route breaching counters to referral before responding.
Done when the authority position on the counter is determined.
verify: Re-test the implied deviation against the authority matrix.
Pass when every breaching counter is routed to referral.

steps.title: Record accept, counter or decline with the technical rationale
sop: Decide accept, counter or decline based on the re-rated position.
Record the technical rationale and the decision date on the renewal file.
Release the response to the broker only after the decision is recorded.
Done when the decision and rationale are recorded before responding.
verify: Open the renewal file and read the recorded decision.
Pass when the counter is assessed against the floor with a recorded accept, counter or decline.

generic.Defined scope/population: Written binding instructions received from the broker for renewals about to incept.
generic.In-scope period: From quote acceptance until the policy expiry date and time.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Quote option, limits, effective date, instruction date and instructing person are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Bound option details reconcile to the quote version named in the instruction.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Instruction document indexed in OpenText with receipt timestamp and channel.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Verbal binders are logged and confirmed in writing within 24 hours.
generic.Test population: All renewals with binding instructions received in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the written binding instruction is dated after the policy expiry date.
generic.Exception handling path: Late or ambiguous instructions escalate to the Renewal Underwriter before any bind.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when a dated written instruction names the exact quote option and all subjectivities are cleared.
generic.Evidence location: Broker & Agent Portal instruction record with the document indexed in OpenText.

steps.title: Receive and timestamp the binding instruction in the Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Capture the broker binding instruction from the portal or email.
Record the receipt timestamp and channel on the account.
Confirm the instruction is written, not implied.
Done when a written instruction is captured with a receipt timestamp.
verify: Compare the instruction timestamp to the policy expiry date and time.
Pass when the written instruction is dated on or before expiry.

steps.title: Check the instruction names the exact quote option, limits and effective date
sop: Match the instruction to the quote version and option being bound.
Confirm limits, deductibles and effective date are stated unambiguously.
Query the broker where any element is ambiguous.
Done when the instruction unambiguously identifies the terms to bind.
verify: Compare the instruction detail to the named quote version.
Pass when instruction and quote option agree on all key terms.

steps.title: Confirm all subjectivities are satisfied or converted to conditions
sop: List the outstanding subjectivities on the quoted terms.
Mark each satisfied with evidence or converted into a policy condition.
Hold the bind where a condition precedent is unmet.
Done when every subjectivity is satisfied or converted.
verify: Filter subjectivities for an open status.
Pass when no condition precedent remains open at bind.

steps.title: Document any verbal binder in writing within 24 hours
sop: Record the verbal binder details, time and parties immediately.
Send written confirmation to the broker within 24 hours.
Index the written confirmation to the renewal file.
Done when every verbal binder has written confirmation on file.
verify: Compare the confirmation timestamp to the verbal binder time.
Pass when written confirmation follows within 24 hours.

steps.title: Verify the accepting party holds binding authority for premium and limit
sop: Check the internal accepting user against the authority matrix.
Confirm the broker signatory is authorised under the agency agreement.
Escalate where authority is insufficient.
Done when both sides of the bind are confirmed authorised.
verify: Re-test the accepting user authority against premium and limit.
Pass when the accepting party authority covers the bound figures.

steps.title: Index the instruction in OpenText and release the renewal to bind
sop: Index the written instruction against policy number and renewal term in OpenText.
Link the OpenText reference to the workstation renewal record.
Set the renewal status to ready to bind.
Done when the instruction is indexed and the renewal is released to bind.
verify: Open the renewal record and follow the instruction link.
Pass when a written broker binding instruction dated on or before expiry is retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: All non-retained renewal accounts requiring a coded loss reason for the cycle.
generic.In-scope period: Renewals reaching expiry without being bound during the reporting cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss reason code, competitor detail where known and achieved-versus-required rate change are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Coded lost accounts reconcile to the lost count in the retention dashboard.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Loss reason recorded on the account with the coding date and the coding underwriter.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Accounts coded as other are logged and reviewed for a better code.
generic.Test population: All renewals with a non-retained outcome in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any non-retained renewal has no coded loss reason.
generic.Exception handling path: Uncoded or wrongly coded losses return to the Renewal Underwriter for correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when every lost renewal carries a standard code and price losses reach the win-back list.
generic.Evidence location: Lost renewal outcome fields in the underwriting workstation feeding the Power BI retention report.

steps.title: List non-retained renewals from the underwriting workstation
sop: Filter the cycle renewal book for accounts not bound at expiry.
Separate insurer-declined renewals from broker or insured-driven losses.
Record the list for coding.
Done when the non-retained population is listed and split by origin.
verify: Compare the list count to the lost count in Power BI.
Pass when both counts agree.

steps.title: Select a standard loss reason code for each lost account
sop: Choose from price, coverage, service, insurer non-renewed or insured ceased trading.
Avoid free-text or other codes where a standard code fits.
Write the code to the account outcome field.
Done when every lost account carries a standard code.
verify: Filter lost accounts for blank or other codes.
Pass when no non-retained renewal is left without a coded loss reason.

steps.title: Record competitor and competing premium where disclosed
sop: Ask the broker for the winning market and premium where not offered.
Record the competitor name and competing premium on the account.
Mark clearly where the broker declined to disclose.
Done when competitor detail is recorded or marked undisclosed.
verify: Check price-coded losses for a competitor field entry.
Pass when each price loss records competitor detail or an undisclosed marker.

steps.title: Record achieved versus required rate change on the lost account
sop: Read the required rate change from the account target.
Record the last offered rate change against that requirement.
Note the gap that the market would not accept.
Done when the achieved-versus-required position is recorded.
verify: Recompute the gap from the offered and target rate changes.
Pass when the recorded gap matches the recalculation.

steps.title: Distinguish insurer-declined renewals in the coding
sop: Review accounts coded as lost that were in fact insurer non-renewals.
Recode them to insurer non-renewed so retention analysis is not distorted.
Record the recoding reason and date.
Done when insurer decisions are separated from market losses.
verify: Cross-check coded losses against the non-renewal notice register.
Pass when every notice-served account is coded insurer non-renewed.

steps.title: Add price-only losses to the win-back list with a review date
sop: Select accounts lost on price alone with acceptable risk quality.
Add them to the win-back list in the workstation.
Set a review date ahead of the next expiry.
Done when every qualifying price loss is on the win-back list.
verify: Filter price-coded losses for win-back list membership.
Pass when qualifying price losses appear on the win-back list with a review date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The negotiation record and final agreed renewal terms for the account.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Offer dates, channels, parties, final premium, limits, deductibles and forms are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documented final terms reconcile to the bound transaction in the policy system.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Negotiation log and broker acceptance stored in OpenText with dates and versions.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Concessions granted are logged with the approval reference that permitted them.
generic.Test population: All renewals that went through broker negotiation in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the broker written acceptance of final terms is not stored on the renewal.
generic.Exception handling path: Discrepancies between documented and bound terms return to the underwriter for correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the full offer history, final terms and broker acceptance are on file and reconciled.
generic.Evidence location: Negotiation log on the renewal file in the workstation with documents indexed in OpenText.

steps.title: Log each offer and counter-offer in the underwriting workstation
sop: Record each offer and counter with date, channel and the person on each side.
Link every entry to the quote version it relates to.
Keep the log in chronological order.
Done when the full offer history is logged in sequence.
verify: Compare the log entries to the portal and email trail.
Pass when every offer exchange appears in the log.

steps.title: Record the final agreed premium, limits, deductibles and forms
sop: Write the final agreed terms into a single summary on the renewal file.
Include premium, limits, deductibles, forms schedule and subjectivities.
Mark the summary as the definitive agreed position.
Done when the final terms are captured in one place.
verify: Compare the summary to the last offer accepted by the broker.
Pass when the summary matches the accepted offer.

steps.title: Store the broker written acceptance in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Obtain the broker written acceptance of the final terms.
Index it in OpenText against the policy and renewal term.
Link the OpenText reference to the renewal file.
Done when the written acceptance is indexed and linked.
verify: Follow the link from the renewal file to the acceptance document.
Pass when the broker written acceptance of final terms is retrievable.

steps.title: Reconcile documented final terms to the bound policy transaction
sop: Compare the documented final terms to the bound record in the policy system.
Investigate and correct any difference in premium, limits or forms.
Record the reconciliation outcome on the file.
Done when documented and bound terms agree.
verify: Re-run the comparison after any correction.
Pass when documented final terms and the bound transaction agree.

steps.title: Note each concession and the approval reference that permitted it
sop: List every concession granted during the negotiation.
Record the approval reference and approver for each.
Flag any concession without an approval reference.
Done when every concession is approval-linked.
verify: Filter the concession list for missing approval references.
Pass when no concession lacks an approval reference.

steps.title: Close the negotiation record and lock it against edit
sop: Confirm the log, final terms and acceptance are all present.
Lock the negotiation record against further edit.
Record the closure date and closing user.
Done when the negotiation record is complete and locked.
verify: Attempt to open the locked record for edit.
Pass when the record is complete and no longer editable.

generic.Defined scope/population: Renewal accounts meeting the strategic-account definition that need a management retention decision.
generic.In-scope period: From strategic identification to a date leaving room to serve a non-renewal notice.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss history, achieved rate change, retention impact, recommendation and walk-away price are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Escalated account count reconciles to the strategic account list for the cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Escalation pack and decision stored on the account with escalation and decision dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Accounts escalated by discretion outside the definition are logged with the reason.
generic.Test population: All strategic accounts renewing in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the management retention decision or its date is missing on a strategic account.
generic.Exception handling path: Undecided escalations are chased daily and raised at the underwriting management meeting.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the decision is recorded within 24 hours and notice timing is still achievable.
generic.Evidence location: Escalation record on the account in the underwriting workstation with the Teams decision trail.

steps.title: Identify accounts meeting the strategic-account definition
sop: Apply the documented strategic-account criteria to the renewal book.
Avoid selecting accounts by personal discretion alone.
List qualifying accounts with days to expiry.
Done when the strategic escalation list is produced by rule.
verify: Re-test listed accounts against the strategic definition.
Pass when every listed account meets the definition.

steps.title: Assemble the escalation pack in the underwriting workstation
sop: Compile loss history, achieved rate change and retention impact.
Add the premium, limits and any coverage changes proposed.
Attach the pricing and appetite position.
Done when the pack contains all required decision inputs.
verify: Check the pack against the required content list.
Pass when no required element is missing from the pack.

steps.title: State the recommended position and the walk-away price
sop: State the recommended retain or walk-away position clearly.
Record the price at which the account should be released.
Justify the recommendation against the technical floor.
Done when recommendation and walk-away price are stated.
verify: Compare the walk-away price to the technical renewal floor.
Pass when the walk-away price is at or above the floor or is approved.

steps.title: Check the escalation timing still permits a non-renewal notice
sop: Calculate days to expiry against the applicable notice period.
Confirm a decline decision could still be served in time.
Escalate immediately where the window is closing.
Done when notice feasibility is confirmed before escalation.
verify: Recompute the latest notice date from the expiry date.
Pass when the escalation is raised inside the notice window.

steps.title: Present the escalation to underwriting management via Teams
sop: Table the pack at the underwriting management forum or a Teams session.
Walk through loss position, rate achieved and retention impact.
Record attendees and the date of presentation.
Done when the escalation is formally presented and logged.
verify: Check the account record for the presentation date and attendees.
Pass when the presentation is logged against the account.

steps.title: Capture the management decision and date within 24 hours
sop: Record the retain or walk-away decision with any price condition.
Write the decision and decision date to the account within 24 hours.
Trigger the non-renewal process where the decision is to walk away.
Done when the decision and date are recorded on the account.
verify: Compare the decision timestamp to the presentation date.
Pass when the management retention decision and date are recorded on the account.

generic.Defined scope/population: The renewal transaction being bound in the policy system for the accepted quote option.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Premium, limits, deductibles, forms, effective date and sanctions result are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Bound premium and limits reconcile exactly to the accepted quote option.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Bind transaction committed with user, timestamp and quote version reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Mismatches between quote and bind are logged and corrected before commit.

steps.title: Confirm sanctions screening on all named insureds is clear and dated
sop: Open the screening record for every named insured on the renewal.
Confirm each result is clear and dated within the acceptable window.
Stop and refer where any hit is unresolved.
Done when all named insureds show a clear dated screen.
verify: Compare screened names to the named insured list on the bind.
Pass when every named insured has a clear dated screening result.

steps.title: Match bound premium, limits, deductibles and forms to the accepted quote
sop: Open the accepted quote version alongside the bind screen.
Compare premium, limits, deductibles and forms line by line.
Correct any difference before committing.
Done when the bind matches the accepted quote exactly.
verify: Re-run the comparison after any correction.
Pass when bound terms and accepted quote agree on every line.

steps.title: Set the renewal effective date to continue cover with no gap
sop: Read the expiring policy expiration date and time.
Set the renewal effective date to follow immediately with no gap.
Check time zone and time of day conventions on both records.
Done when the renewal effective date abuts the expiring expiration.
verify: Compare expiring expiration and renewal effective dates.
Pass when no gap exists between the two dates.

steps.title: Confirm the binding user authority covers the bound premium and limit
sop: Check the binding user authority band in the authority matrix.

Route to a higher authority user where insufficient.
Done when the binding user authority covers the transaction.
verify: Re-test the binding user band against the bound figures.
Pass when the bound figures sit inside the binding user authority.

steps.title: Commit the renewal transaction in Guidewire PolicyCenter
sop: Execute the bind transaction in PolicyCenter.
Confirm the transaction commits without validation errors.
Confirm the policy status moves to Bound or In Force.
Done when the renewal transaction is committed and in force.
verify: Reopen the policy and read the status and transaction history.
Pass when the policy shows In Force with the renewal transaction committed.

steps.title: Link the bound transaction back to the renewal file in the workstation
sop: Record the policy transaction reference on the renewal file.
Attach the bind confirmation to the account record.
Close the renewal workflow item as bound.
Done when the bound transaction is referenced on the renewal file.
verify: Follow the transaction reference from the renewal file.
Pass when the reference resolves to the committed renewal transaction.

generic.Defined scope/population: Price and coverage terms under negotiation with the broker to defend the renewal.

steps.title: Set the target price and walk-away price before opening negotiation

Set an opening target price and an explicit walk-away price.
Record both on the account before contacting the broker.
Done when target and walk-away prices are recorded pre-negotiation.
verify: Compare the record timestamps to the first negotiation contact.

Pass when no concession was offered without being priced.

verify: Compare the final agreed premium to the floor and any approval.
Pass when below-floor outcomes carry a recorded referral approval.

steps.title: Test the negotiated outcome against equivalent new-business pricing
sop: Price the same risk as a new-business submission in Earnix.
Compare the negotiated renewal position to that price.
Adjust or justify where the renewal is more favourable without basis.
Done when the renewal-versus-new-business comparison is documented.
verify: Re-read the new-business comparison scenario.
Pass when the renewal is not priced more favourably than an equivalent new risk without justification.

steps.title: Agree the final position with the broker through the portal
sop: Confirm the agreed premium, limits, deductibles and coverage in writing.
Send the agreed position through the Broker & Agent Portal.
Ask the broker to confirm acceptance in writing.
Done when the agreed position is confirmed in writing by both sides.
verify: Open the portal thread and read the broker confirmation.
Pass when a written broker confirmation of the agreed position exists.

steps.title: Log the agreed position, date and broker contact on the account
sop: Write the agreed position and its date to the account negotiation record.
Name the broker contact who agreed it.
Link the Earnix scenario supporting the agreed premium.
Done when the agreed position is fully logged.
verify: Open the account negotiation record and read the logged fields.
Pass when the agreed position, date and broker contact are all recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Revised renewal terms that exceed the previously approved authority envelope.
generic.In-scope period: From the terms revision until the revised quote is reissued to the broker.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Change since original approval, movement size, original approval reference and new approver are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Revised premium and limits reconcile to the revised Earnix rating and the referral submission.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Second approval record stored with submission and decision timestamps on the account.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Re-referrals declined are logged with the required corrective terms.
generic.Test population: All renewals whose terms changed after an initial referral approval.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the second approval is dated before the revised terms were prepared.
generic.Exception handling path: Movements beyond director authority escalate to the next authority level.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the re-approval is recorded with revised conditions before any reissue.
generic.Evidence location: Referral history on the renewal account in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Identify what changed since the original approval in the workstation
sop: Compare the revised terms to the terms originally approved.
List each element that moved and quantify the movement.
Record the comparison on the re-referral form.
Done when every change since the original approval is quantified.
verify: Compare the change list to the original approval record.
Pass when every difference from the approved terms is listed.

steps.title: Test whether the revised terms exceed the approved authority envelope
sop: Map the revised position against the authority matrix band.
Confirm the movement takes the account outside the prior approval envelope.
Avoid re-referring where the change stays inside the envelope.
Done when the need for re-approval is confirmed or ruled out.
verify: Re-test the revised figures against the authority matrix.
Pass when re-referral is raised only where the envelope is exceeded.

steps.title: Submit the revised pricing and coverage package with the original reference
sop: Attach the revised rating output and coverage schedule to the referral.
Quote the original approval reference on the submission.
State the underwriter recommendation on the revised terms.
Done when the re-referral is submitted with full supporting material.
verify: Open the submission and check for the original approval reference.
Pass when the original approval reference is attached to the re-referral.

steps.title: Obtain the re-approval decision from the Underwriting Director
sop: Review the movement, revised pricing and coverage position.
Decide approve, approve with revised conditions or decline.
Record the decision and decision date on the account.
Done when the re-approval decision is recorded.
verify: Compare the decision timestamp to the revised terms preparation date.
Pass when the second approval is dated after the revised terms were prepared.

steps.title: Record the new approver, date and any revised conditions
sop: Write the new approver name and approval date to the account.
Record every revised condition attached to the approval.
Link the record to the original referral history.
Done when approver, date and conditions are recorded.
verify: Read back the approval record fields on the account.
Pass when approver, date and revised conditions are all populated.

steps.title: Hold the revised quote until the re-approval is recorded
sop: Check the re-approval status before any reissue to the broker.
Apply the revised conditions into the quote before release.
Release the quote only once the approval is on the account.
Done when the revised quote is released only after re-approval.
verify: Compare the reissue timestamp to the approval timestamp.
Pass when no revised quote reached the broker before the re-approval was recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Approved renewal terms being presented to the producing broker for the account.
generic.In-scope period: From terms approval to the broker acknowledgement of receipt.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Premium, limits, deductibles, forms, changes from expiring and validity dates are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Presented premium and limits reconcile to the approved quote in the workstation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Presentation logged on the account with date, channel and the document version sent.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Broker questions and objections are logged with the response given.
generic.Test population: All renewal accounts where terms were presented in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if broker receipt of the renewal terms is not logged with a date.
generic.Exception handling path: Unacknowledged presentations are chased and escalated to the Renewal Underwriter.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when itemised terms, explicit changes and binding deadlines are received and acknowledged.
generic.Evidence location: Broker & Agent Portal presentation record with the Teams or email trail on the account.

steps.title: Assemble the terms presentation from the approved quote
sop: Itemise premium, limits, deductibles and the forms schedule.
Confirm the figures match the approved quote version.
Prepare the presentation document for the broker.
Done when the presentation itemises all approved terms.
verify: Compare the presentation figures to the approved quote.
Pass when presentation and approved quote agree.

steps.title: Call out every change from expiring terms explicitly
sop: List each difference from the expiring policy on its own line.
Highlight coverage reductions and deductible increases clearly.
Avoid leaving changes for the broker to discover by comparison.
Done when every change from expiring is explicitly stated.
verify: Compare the change list to the approved coverage change set.
Pass when both lists agree line for line.

steps.title: State the quote validity date and the binding instruction deadline
sop: Print the quote validity expiry date on the presentation.
State the date by which binding instructions are required.
Diarise both dates in the underwriting workstation.
Done when both deadlines appear on the presented terms.
verify: Read the deadlines on the presented document.
Pass when validity and binding deadlines are both stated.

steps.title: Deliver the terms through the Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Upload the terms to the portal against the correct account.
Send the accompanying note through Microsoft Teams or email.
Record the delivery date, channel and recipient.
Done when the terms are delivered to the producing broker.
verify: Check the portal delivery record for the account.
Pass when the delivery record shows the correct account and date.

steps.title: Confirm broker acknowledgement of receipt
sop: Request explicit acknowledgement from the broker.
Chase where no acknowledgement is received within the standard.
Record the acknowledgement date and person.
Done when the broker acknowledgement is recorded.
verify: Open the account activity record and read the acknowledgement.
Pass when broker receipt of renewal terms is logged with a date.

steps.title: Log the presentation date and broker questions on the account
sop: Write the presentation date and channel to the account activity record.
Log every question or objection raised by the broker.
Route substantive questions to the handling underwriter.
Done when the presentation and all questions are logged.
verify: Read the activity record for presentation and question entries.
Pass when the presentation date and any questions raised are recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Broker responses received against issued renewal quotes for the account book.
generic.In-scope period: From quote issue until the response is classified and routed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Response type, response date, quote version and competing quote detail are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Logged responses reconcile to the quotes issued and still open in the workstation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Broker written response attached to the specific quote version with a receipt timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Responses not acknowledged inside four hours are logged as service breaches.
generic.Test population: All broker responses received on renewal quotes in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a response is not classified or is attached to the wrong quote version.
generic.Exception handling path: Ambiguous responses are clarified with the broker before classification.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the response is acknowledged, classified, version-linked and routed the same day.
generic.Evidence location: Quote response record in the underwriting workstation with the portal message trail.

steps.title: Capture the broker response from the Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Open the portal message or email carrying the broker response.
Record the receipt timestamp and the responding contact.
Save the written response to the account.
Done when the response is captured with a receipt timestamp.
verify: Compare the captured timestamp to the portal record.
Pass when the recorded receipt time matches the portal.

steps.title: Acknowledge the broker response within the four-hour service standard
sop: Send the acknowledgement to the broker within four hours of receipt.
State who is handling the response and the expected next step.
Log the acknowledgement time on the account.
Done when the acknowledgement is sent and logged.
verify: Compare acknowledgement time to receipt time.
Pass when the acknowledgement falls inside the four-hour standard.

steps.title: Classify the response as accept, counter, decline or awaiting insured
sop: Read the response and select the matching classification.
Query the broker where the response is ambiguous.
Write the classification to the quote response field.
Done when every response carries a classification.
verify: Filter responses for blank or ambiguous classifications.
Pass when every logged response is classified.

steps.title: Attach the response to the specific quote version it relates to
sop: Identify the quote version the broker is responding to.
Link the response document to that version in the workstation.
Correct links where the broker replied to a superseded version.
Done when the response is linked to the correct quote version.
verify: Open the quote version and confirm the response is attached.
Pass when the response is dated against the correct quote version.

steps.title: Record competing quote details disclosed by the broker
sop: Capture any competitor name and premium the broker discloses.
Record the coverage differences mentioned.
Mark clearly where nothing was disclosed.
Done when competing quote detail is recorded or marked undisclosed.
verify: Check price-related responses for competitor fields.
Pass when disclosed competitor detail is recorded on the account.

steps.title: Route counters and declines to the handling underwriter the same day
sop: Move counter and decline responses to the handling underwriter queue.
Confirm the routing happens on the day of receipt.
Set the response due date for the underwriter.
Done when all counters and declines are routed the same day.
verify: Compare routing timestamps to receipt timestamps.
Pass when no counter or decline was routed later than the day of receipt.

generic.Defined scope/population: Renewal outcomes for every account that reached its expiry decision in the cycle.
generic.In-scope period: Renewals with an expiry date inside the reporting cycle window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Outcome, achieved rate change, final premium, expiring premium and segment are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Outcome counts reconcile to the renewal book listing for the same expiry window.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Outcome recorded on the account with the recording date and recording user.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Accounts closed without an outcome are logged and reopened for completion.
generic.Test population: All renewals that passed their expiry date in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any expired renewal is left with a blank retention outcome.
generic.Exception handling path: Blank or inconsistent outcomes return to the Renewal Underwriter before workflow closure.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when outcome, rate change and like-for-like premium comparison flow to the dashboard.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal outcome fields in the underwriting workstation feeding the Power BI retention dashboard.

steps.title: List expired renewals awaiting an outcome in the workstation
sop: Filter the renewal book for accounts past their expiry date.
Isolate those with a blank outcome field.
Record the population needing completion.
Done when the outstanding outcome list is produced.
verify: Compare the list to the renewal book listing for the window.
Pass when the population matches the expired renewal count.

steps.title: Record the outcome as retained, lost or insurer non-renewed
sop: Select the outcome that matches what actually happened at expiry.
Separate insurer non-renewals from market losses.
Write the outcome to the account.
Done when every expired renewal carries an outcome.
verify: Re-run the blank outcome filter.
Pass when no expired renewal is left with a blank retention outcome.

steps.title: Record the achieved rate change against the account target
sop: Read the achieved pure rate change from the premium comparison.
Record it beside the account rate-change target.
Note the variance in basis points.
Done when achieved rate change and target are both recorded.
verify: Recompute the achieved rate change from the bound and restated expiring premium.
Pass when the recorded figure matches the recalculation.

steps.title: Record final premium against expiring on a like-for-like basis
sop: Use the restated expiring premium for the comparison.
Record the final bound premium beside it.
Note any exposure change that breaks like-for-like comparability.
Done when the like-for-like premium comparison is recorded.
verify: Check the comparison uses the restated expiring figure.
Pass when the comparison is on a like-for-like basis.

steps.title: Confirm the outcome flows to the correct segment in Power BI
sop: Refresh the retention dashboard after outcomes are recorded.
Confirm the account appears under the correct segment.
Correct segment mapping errors at source.
Done when the outcome appears in the right dashboard segment.
verify: Trace one account from the dashboard back to its workstation record.
Pass when the dashboard segment matches the account segment.

steps.title: Close the renewal workflow item once the outcome is recorded
sop: Check outcome, rate change and premium fields are complete.
Close the renewal workflow item in the workstation.
Record the closure date and user.
Done when the workflow item is closed with a complete outcome.
verify: Search closed workflow items for blank outcome fields.
Pass when no workflow item was closed without an outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: Revised renewal quotes to be reissued to the broker after approved changes.
generic.In-scope period: Within five business days of the revised terms being approved.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Quote version, change summary, revised validity date and delivery record are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Active quote count per account equals one after the reissue.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reissued quote saved as a new version with issue date and delivery channel.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reissues beyond five business days are logged with the delay reason.
generic.Test population: All renewal accounts with a revised quote reissued in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if more than one quote version is active on an account after reissue.
generic.Exception handling path: Superseded versions still marked active are corrected before broker follow-up.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when a new version is issued, priors are superseded and receipt is logged.
generic.Evidence location: Quote version history in the underwriting workstation with the portal delivery record.

steps.title: Create the revised quote as a new version in the workstation
sop: Generate a new quote version rather than editing the original document.
Carry the approved revised terms into the new version.
Record the version number and creation date.
Done when a distinct new quote version exists.
verify: Open the quote history and confirm a new version number.
Pass when the revision is a new version, not an edited original.

steps.title: Mark the prior quote version as superseded
sop: Set the prior version status to superseded in the workstation.
Confirm only the new version remains active on the account.
Record who superseded the version and when.
Done when only one live offer exists on the account.
verify: Count active quote versions on the account.
Pass when only one active quote version remains with priors superseded.

steps.title: Show what changed from the previous quote on the reissue
sop: List premium, term and validity changes against the prior version.
Place the change summary on the face of the reissued quote.
Explain the reason for each change briefly.
Done when the reissue states every change from the prior version.
verify: Compare the change summary to the version difference.
Pass when the summary covers every changed element.

steps.title: Set the revised validity date on the reissued quote
sop: Set a new validity expiry date appropriate to the time to expiry.
Print the validity date on the reissued document.
Diarise the new validity expiry.
Done when the reissue carries a revised validity date.
verify: Read the validity date on the reissued document.
Pass when a new validity date is present on the reissue.

steps.title: Reissue within five business days of approval through the portal
sop: Check the approval date for the revised terms.
Deliver the reissued quote through the Broker & Agent Portal.
Log the reissue date and channel.
Done when the reissue is delivered inside the five-day standard.
verify: Compare reissue date to the revised terms approval date.
Pass when the reissue falls within five business days of approval.

steps.title: Confirm broker receipt of the reissued quote and log the date
sop: Request broker confirmation of receipt for the new version.
Log the confirmation date and the confirming contact.
Chase where no confirmation is received.
Done when broker receipt of the reissue is logged.
verify: Open the account activity record for the receipt entry.
Pass when the reissued quote receipt is logged with a date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Renewal quote revisions being made inside the underwriter delegated authority.
generic.In-scope period: From the revision decision to the new quote validity expiry date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Revised premium, deviation applied, minimum premium check and new validity date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Revised quote premium reconciles to the Earnix re-rating output.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Revised rating worksheet saved with tool version and revision date on the renewal file.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Revisions exceeding delegated authority are logged and converted into referrals.
generic.Test population: All renewal quote revisions prepared in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the revised premium was adjusted manually instead of re-rated in the pricing tool.
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-authority revisions stop and route to the referral process instead.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the revision is re-rated, within authority, above minimum and newly dated.
generic.Evidence location: Earnix revision worksheet with the revised quote in Guidewire PolicyCenter.

steps.title: Re-rate the revised terms in Earnix rather than adjusting premium manually
sop: Enter the revised terms as a new rating scenario in Earnix.
Produce the revised technical premium from the tool.
Discard any manually adjusted premium figure.
Done when the revised premium comes from the pricing tool.
verify: Compare the quote premium to the Earnix scenario output.
Pass when the revised premium matches the tool output exactly.

steps.title: Confirm the rate deviation applied sits inside the authority matrix allowance
sop: Calculate the deviation implied by the revised premium.
Compare it to the deviation allowance for the handling underwriter.
Stop and refer where the allowance is exceeded.
Done when the deviation is confirmed inside the allowance.
verify: Re-test the deviation against the authority matrix.
Pass when the applied deviation is inside the delegated allowance.

steps.title: Check the revised premium still clears the class minimum premium
sop: Read the minimum premium rule for the class and state.
Compare the revised premium to that minimum.
Raise the premium or refer where it falls short.
Done when the revised premium clears the minimum.
verify: Re-read the minimum premium rule and recompare.
Pass when the revised premium is at or above the class minimum.

steps.title: Update the quote validity and expiry date on the revision
sop: Set a new validity period appropriate to the remaining time to expiry.
Update the validity expiry date on the revised quote.
Diarise the new date in the workstation.
Done when the revised quote carries an updated validity date.
verify: Read the validity date on the revised quote.
Pass when the revised quote carries a new validity date.

steps.title: Load the revised terms into the Guidewire PolicyCenter quote
sop: Transfer the revised premium and terms into the PolicyCenter quote.
Confirm the forms schedule reflects any coverage revision.
Resolve any variance between tool and policy system.
Done when PolicyCenter reflects the revised terms.
verify: Compare PolicyCenter premium and forms to the Earnix scenario.
Pass when both systems agree on premium and terms.

steps.title: Confirm the revision stays inside delegated authority or raise a referral
sop: Review the revision against premium, limit and deviation authority.
Approve continuation where it stays inside authority.
Convert the revision into a referral where it does not.
Done when the authority position on the revision is settled.
verify: Re-test the revised position against the authority matrix.
Pass when the revised quote is re-rated, newly dated and inside authority or referred.

generic.Defined scope/population: The post-endorsement risk position for the policy being changed mid-term.
generic.In-scope period: From the endorsement effective date to the policy expiry date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Post-endorsement total insured value, limit, premium and referral conclusion are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Post-endorsement totals reconcile to the revised schedule supplied with the request.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Referral assessment recorded on the endorsement with the assessment date and assessor.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Endorsements introducing out-of-appetite exposure are logged with the referral trigger.
generic.Test population: All mid-term endorsement requests reaching underwriting assessment.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if authority is tested against the original policy figures instead of post-endorsement figures.
generic.Exception handling path: Treaty or appetite breaches route to the Senior Underwriter before the endorsement proceeds.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when post-change figures are tested against authority and the conclusion is recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Endorsement assessment record in the underwriting workstation with PolicyCenter figures.

steps.title: Recalculate post-endorsement values and limits in Guidewire PolicyCenter
sop: Apply the requested change to the policy schedule in a rating scenario.
Recalculate total insured value, aggregate limit and premium after the change.
Record the pre and post figures side by side.
Done when post-endorsement figures are calculated.
verify: Reconcile post-endorsement totals to the revised schedule supplied.
Pass when calculated totals match the supplied schedule.

steps.title: Test the revised figures against the handling underwriter authority band
sop: Read the handling underwriter authority band from the matrix.
Compare post-endorsement premium and limit to that band.
Do not test against the original policy figures.
Done when the post-change position is tested against authority.
verify: Re-run the authority test using the post-endorsement figures.
Pass when the test uses post-change limit and premium.

steps.title: Flag new locations, classes or coverages outside appetite
sop: Compare added locations, classes and coverages to the current appetite guide.
Flag any element outside appetite or on the prohibited list.
Record the appetite reference behind each flag.
Done when out-of-appetite additions are flagged.
verify: Re-check added elements against the appetite guide.
Pass when every out-of-appetite addition carries a flag.

steps.title: Assess whether the change affects reinsurance treaty fit
sop: Compare the post-endorsement limit and exposure to treaty capacity and scope.
Flag changes that would push the risk outside treaty terms.
Note where facultative placement may be required.
Done when the treaty fit position is assessed.
verify: Re-read the treaty capacity for the class and compare.
Pass when any treaty breach is flagged before the endorsement proceeds.

steps.title: Record the referral-required conclusion with the trigger reference
sop: Record a clear referral-required yes or no on the endorsement.
Cite the specific trigger reference where referral is required.
Route the endorsement accordingly.
Done when the conclusion and trigger are recorded.
verify: Open the endorsement record and read the conclusion.
Pass when the post-endorsement test and conclusion are both recorded.

steps.title: Route referral-triggering endorsements to the Senior Underwriter
sop: Receive the flagged endorsement with its assessment pack.
Confirm the trigger and the authority level required.
Progress to the approval step or return for correction.
Done when every flagged endorsement is routed to the correct level.
verify: Check flagged endorsements for correct queue placement.
Pass when no flagged endorsement remains in a standard queue.

generic.Defined scope/population: The additional or return premium arising from the endorsement for the remaining policy term.
generic.In-scope period: From the endorsement effective date to the policy expiry date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Effective date, days remaining, rate set applied, pro-rata basis and AP or RP amount are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Recalculated policy premium equals expiring premium plus the calculated AP or RP.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Calculation output saved with the rating version and calculation date on the endorsement.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Premiums falling below the term minimum are logged and corrected before issue.
generic.Test population: All endorsement premium calculations produced in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the calculation does not show the pro-rata basis and the effective-to-expiry day count.
generic.Exception handling path: Incorrect rate sets or bases are returned to the assistant for recalculation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the AP or RP is calculated on inception rates with a shown day-count basis.
generic.Evidence location: Endorsement premium calculation in the policy administration system with the Earnix worksheet.

steps.title: Set the endorsement effective date in the policy administration system
sop: Enter the approved endorsement effective date on the transaction.
Confirm it is not backdated beyond the permitted window.
Calculate the days remaining to policy expiry.
Done when the effective date and day count are set.
verify: Recompute the days from effective date to expiry.
Pass when the day count matches the recalculation.

steps.title: Apply the filed rates in force at policy inception in Earnix
sop: Select the rate set effective at the policy inception date.
Confirm current new-business rates are not applied.
Record the rate version used on the calculation.
Done when the inception rate set is applied.
verify: Compare the applied rate version to the policy inception date.
Pass when the rates applied are those in force at inception.

steps.title: Confirm short-rate versus pro-rata treatment against the policy wording
sop: Read the policy wording treatment for the change type.
Select short-rate or pro-rata accordingly.
Record the basis and the wording clause relied on.
Done when the correct basis is selected and evidenced.
verify: Re-read the wording clause against the selected basis.
Pass when the basis matches the wording for the change type.

steps.title: Calculate the additional or return premium to expiry
sop: Compute the premium difference for the remaining term on the chosen basis.
Show the AP or RP amount separately from the full-term premium.
Display the days-remaining basis on the output.
Done when the AP or RP amount is calculated and displayed.
verify: Recompute the AP or RP from the day count and rate difference.
Pass when the pro-rata basis and day count are shown on the calculation.

steps.title: Check the resulting policy premium meets the term minimum
sop: Add the AP or RP to the existing term premium.
Compare the result to the minimum premium for the term.
Adjust or refer where the minimum is breached.
Done when the revised term premium clears the minimum.
verify: Re-read the minimum premium rule and recompare.
Pass when the revised term premium is at or above the minimum.

steps.title: Post the calculation to the endorsement transaction record
sop: Attach the calculation output to the endorsement transaction.
Record the rating version and calculation date.
Make the AP or RP visible for document generation.
Done when the calculation is posted to the transaction.
verify: Open the transaction and read the attached calculation.
Pass when the AP or RP with its basis is retrievable from the transaction.

generic.Defined scope/population: The authority approval record for the endorsement being executed on the policy.
generic.In-scope period: From approval receipt until the endorsement execution timestamp.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approver name, approval date, approved terms and any conditions are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Approved terms in the record match the terms on the endorsement transaction.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approval document indexed in OpenText against the specific endorsement transaction.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Approvals filed against the policy generally rather than the transaction are corrected and logged.
generic.Test population: All endorsements requiring authority approval in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the approval record is dated after the endorsement execution timestamp.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing or misfiled approvals stop execution until the record is corrected.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when a transaction-linked approval names approver, date, terms and conditions.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText endorsement folder linked from the endorsement record in the workstation.

steps.title: Obtain the approval record from the underwriting workstation referral
sop: Open the endorsement referral and export the approval decision.
Capture approver name, decision date and approved terms.
Note any conditions attached to the approval.
Done when the approval record is captured in full.
verify: Compare the captured record to the referral decision screen.
Pass when the captured record matches the referral decision.

steps.title: Attach the approval to the specific endorsement transaction
sop: Index the approval document to the endorsement transaction reference.
Avoid filing it against the general policy file only.
Link the OpenText reference into the endorsement record.
Done when the approval is attached at transaction level.
verify: Open the endorsement transaction and follow the approval link.
Pass when the approval opens from the transaction, not just the policy file.

steps.title: Confirm the approval names approver, date and exact approved terms
sop: Read the approval for approver identity and decision date.
Confirm the approved limits, premium and coverage are stated exactly.
Return the approval for clarification where terms are vague.
Done when the approval states approver, date and exact terms.
verify: Compare the stated approved terms to the endorsement terms.
Pass when approved terms and endorsement terms agree.

steps.title: Confirm the approver held sufficient authority for the post-change exposure
sop: Read the post-endorsement premium and limit.
Compare them to the approver authority band in the matrix.
Escalate for a higher approval where the band is insufficient.
Done when approver authority is confirmed sufficient.
verify: Re-test the approver band against the post-change figures.
Pass when the approver authority covers the post-endorsement exposure.

steps.title: Record every condition attached to the approval on the endorsement
sop: List each condition stated in the approval.
Record them on the endorsement so they carry into execution.
Flag conditions that must be met before execution.
Done when all approval conditions are recorded on the endorsement.
verify: Compare the recorded conditions to the approval document.
Pass when every approval condition appears on the endorsement.

steps.title: Hold execution until the approval document is filed
sop: Check the approval is filed before allowing execution.
Block the transaction where the approval is missing.
Release for execution once the filing is confirmed.
Done when execution proceeds only after filing.
verify: Compare the approval filing timestamp to the execution timestamp.
Pass when the approval record is dated on or before the endorsement execution.

generic.Defined scope/population: The endorsement document to be generated and delivered to the producing broker.
generic.In-scope period: From endorsement execution to broker delivery and filing.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Effective date, change description, AP or RP amount and endorsement number are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Endorsement number sequence follows the prior endorsement on the policy without gaps.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued document filed against the policy with delivery date, channel and recipient.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Undelivered or bounced deliveries are logged and re-sent with the reason recorded.
generic.Test population: All endorsement documents issued in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the endorsement delivery date or recipient is not logged against the policy.
generic.Exception handling path: Documents generated on an unfiled form version are regenerated before delivery.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when a filed-form endorsement is delivered to the broker and logged with a date.
generic.Evidence location: Broker & Agent Portal delivery record with the document copy indexed in OpenText.

steps.title: Generate the endorsement from the policy administration system
sop: Generate the endorsement document from the committed transaction.
Confirm the form version used is currently filed for the state.
Regenerate where a superseded form was applied.
Done when the document is generated on a filed form version.
verify: Check the generated form version against the filed forms list.
Pass when the document uses a currently filed form version.

steps.title: Check the document states effective date, change and AP or RP
sop: Read the generated document for the endorsement effective date.
Confirm the change made is described clearly.
Confirm the AP or RP amount is shown.
Done when all three elements appear on the document.
verify: Compare the document content to the endorsement transaction.
Pass when effective date, change and premium effect all match.

steps.title: Confirm the endorsement number follows the prior sequence
sop: Read the last endorsement number issued on the policy.
Confirm the new number follows without a gap or duplicate.
Correct the sequence in the policy system where wrong.
Done when the endorsement number is correctly sequenced.
verify: List the policy endorsement numbers in order.
Pass when the sequence runs without gaps or duplicates.

steps.title: Deliver the endorsement to the producing broker through the portal
sop: Upload the endorsement to the Broker & Agent Portal for the account.
Notify the producing broker of the delivery.
Record the delivery date, channel and recipient.
Done when the endorsement is delivered to the producing broker.
verify: Open the portal delivery record for the endorsement.
Pass when delivery date and recipient are logged against the policy.

steps.title: File the issued endorsement copy in OpenText against the policy
sop: Index the issued document to policy number and endorsement number.
Link the OpenText reference into the policy record.
Confirm the copy is the version actually delivered.
Done when the issued copy is indexed and linked.
verify: Follow the policy record link to the filed document.
Pass when the filed copy matches the delivered version.

steps.title: Log and re-send any failed delivery
sop: Monitor the portal and email for delivery failures.
Log any failure with its reason on the policy record.
Re-send and record the successful delivery date.
Done when every endorsement has a successful logged delivery.
verify: Filter endorsements for missing delivery confirmations.
Pass when no issued endorsement is left without a logged delivery.

generic.Defined scope/population: Mid-term cession adjustments arising from the endorsement on the affected policy.
generic.In-scope period: From the endorsement effective date to the end of the current accounting period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Ceded premium, ceded limit, treaty or facultative reference and notification date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ceded premium advised reconciles to the endorsement premium and the cession percentage.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notification stored with date, recipient and the ceded amount advised on the policy record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Limits exceeding treaty capacity are logged and flagged for facultative placement.
generic.Test population: All endorsements changing ceded exposure in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the cession adjustment posted does not match the endorsement effective date and premium.
generic.Exception handling path: Capacity breaches route to the Underwriter for a facultative placement decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the cession is recalculated, capacity tested and advised before period close.
generic.Evidence location: Sapiens ReinsurancePro cession record with the notification logged on the policy.

steps.title: Identify whether the endorsement changes ceded exposure
sop: Read the endorsement change and the policy reinsurance arrangement.
Determine whether proportional or facultative cession is affected.
Record the arrangement type on the notification.
Done when the affected cession arrangement is identified.
verify: Compare the identified arrangement to the policy reinsurance record.
Pass when the arrangement type matches the policy record.

steps.title: Recalculate ceded premium and ceded limit from the effective date
sop: Apply the cession percentage to the endorsement premium.
Recalculate the ceded limit on the post-endorsement position.
Prorate from the endorsement effective date.
Done when ceded premium and limit are recalculated.
verify: Recompute the ceded premium from the endorsement premium and cession rate.
Pass when the recalculated figure matches the advised amount.

steps.title: Test the post-endorsement limit against treaty capacity in Sapiens
sop: Read the treaty capacity and scope for the class in Sapiens ReinsurancePro.
Compare the post-endorsement limit to that capacity.
Flag a facultative requirement where capacity is exceeded.
Done when the treaty capacity position is confirmed.
verify: Re-read the treaty capacity and recompare the limit.
Pass when any capacity breach is flagged for facultative placement.

steps.title: Send the cession adjustment to reinsurance accounting before period close
sop: Prepare the cession adjustment advice with policy, endorsement and amounts.
Send it to reinsurance accounting through Microsoft Teams or email.
Confirm it lands before the accounting period close date.
Done when the advice is sent before period close.
verify: Compare the send date to the period close date.
Pass when the advice was sent before the close.

steps.title: Post the cession adjustment in Sapiens ReinsurancePro
sop: Enter the cession adjustment with the endorsement effective date.
Confirm the ceded premium posted matches the advice.
Resolve any posting rejection before proceeding.
Done when the cession adjustment is posted.
verify: Open the posted cession and compare date and amount.
Pass when the posting matches the endorsement effective date and premium.

steps.title: Log the notification date and ceded amount on the policy record
sop: Record the notification date, recipient and ceded amount advised.
Attach the advice to the policy record.
Note any acknowledgement received.
Done when the notification is logged on the policy.
verify: Open the policy record and read the notification entry.
Pass when notification date and ceded amount advised are both recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Endorsements requiring underwriting authority approval before execution.
generic.In-scope period: From referral submission to the approval decision within the 24-hour standard.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Pre and post exposure, premium, recommendation, approver and decision date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Referred endorsement count reconciles to the flagged population from the referral assessment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Referral and decision stored with submission and decision timestamps in the workstation.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Decisions taken beyond 24 hours are logged with the delay reason.
generic.Test population: All endorsement referrals raised in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any endorsement is executed with an approval timestamp later than execution.
generic.Exception handling path: Referrals above the approver band escalate to the next authority level before decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the correct level approves within 24 hours and before execution.
generic.Evidence location: Endorsement referral record on the policy in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Submit the endorsement referral with pre and post change figures
sop: Record the pre-change and post-change exposure, limit and premium.
Attach the endorsement request and supporting schedule.
Submit the referral in the underwriting workstation.
Done when the referral is submitted with both positions shown.
verify: Open the referral and read the pre and post figures.
Pass when both positions are present on the submission.

steps.title: Route the referral to the level covering the post-endorsement position
sop: Map the post-change figures to the authority matrix band.
Select the approver level covering that band.
Record the routing rationale on the referral.
Done when the referral sits with the correct approval level.
verify: Re-test the post-change figures against the matrix.
Pass when the referral is with the level covering the post-change position.

steps.title: Include the underwriter recommendation and pricing for added exposure
sop: Write the recommendation with the technical rationale.
Attach the pricing for the added or removed exposure.
State any conditions the underwriter proposes.
Done when recommendation and pricing accompany the referral.
verify: Check the referral attachments for recommendation and pricing.
Pass when both are present and current.

steps.title: Obtain the Senior Underwriter assessment where required
sop: Review the exposure movement and the pricing applied.
Record support, challenge or rejection with reasons.
Pass to the director level where the band requires it.
Done when the senior assessment is recorded.
verify: Read the recorded assessment on the referral.
Pass when a dated senior assessment precedes the final decision.

steps.title: Record the approval decision within 24 hours of referral
sop: Decide approve, approve with conditions or decline.
Record the decision, approver and timestamp on the referral.
Log the delay reason where the decision exceeds 24 hours.
Done when the decision is recorded with a timestamp.
verify: Compare decision timestamp to submission timestamp.
Pass when the decision falls inside the 24-hour standard or the delay is logged.

steps.title: Block endorsement execution until approval is granted
sop: Check referral status before any execution in the policy system.
Hold the transaction where approval is not recorded.
Release for execution once approval is confirmed.
Done when execution follows approval, never precedes it.
verify: Compare approval and execution timestamps across the period.
Pass when no endorsement carries an approval timestamp later than execution.
