generic.Defined scope/population: Endorsement requests received from brokers against in-force policies.
generic.In-scope period: From request receipt through acknowledgement within the four-hour standard.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy and term, request type, requested effective date and supporting data are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Logged requests reconcile to the inbound portal and email request count for the day.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Request logged with receipt timestamp, channel and the broker contact named.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests with missing supporting data are logged as incomplete with a chase date.
generic.Test population: All endorsement requests received in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if request type, requested effective date or acknowledgement timestamp is missing.
generic.Exception handling path: Backdated requests beyond the permitted window route to the Underwriter for a decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the request is logged to the right policy, classified, dated and acknowledged.
generic.Evidence location: Endorsement request record in the underwriting workstation with the portal message.

steps.title: Log the request against the correct in-force policy and term
sop: Match the request to the policy number and the current in-force term.
Confirm the policy is in force at the requested effective date.
Create the endorsement request record in the workstation.
Done when the request is logged against the right policy and term.
verify: Compare the logged policy and term to the request document.
Pass when the request is attached to the correct in-force term.

steps.title: Classify the request type in the underwriting workstation
sop: Select exposure change, coverage addition or policy correction.
Query the broker where the request spans several types.
Write the classification to the request record.
Done when the request carries a classification.
verify: Filter requests for blank classifications.
Pass when every logged request has a request type.

steps.title: Capture the requested effective date and test for backdating
sop: Record the requested effective date on the request.
Compare it to the permitted backdating window.
Flag requests backdated beyond the window for underwriter decision.
Done when the effective date is captured and tested.
verify: Recompute the backdating days from the request date.
Pass when every out-of-window request is flagged.

steps.title: Confirm supporting data is attached to the request
sop: Check for updated schedules, values or unit details as applicable.
Request missing items from the broker through the portal.
Mark the request complete or incomplete accordingly.
Done when the supporting data position is recorded.
verify: Compare attached documents to the data requirement for the request type.
Pass when incomplete requests are marked and chased.

steps.title: Acknowledge receipt to the broker within four hours
sop: Send the acknowledgement through the Broker & Agent Portal.
State the handling reference and expected turnaround.
Record the acknowledgement timestamp on the request.
Done when the acknowledgement is sent and timestamped.
verify: Compare acknowledgement time to receipt time.
Pass when the acknowledgement falls inside the four-hour standard.

steps.title: Set the service due date and route to the Underwriter
sop: Set the service due date from the request type standard.
Route the request to the handling underwriter queue.
Confirm the underwriter has the supporting data needed.
Done when the request is routed with a service due date.
verify: Open the request record and read type, effective date and acknowledgement.
Pass when request type, requested effective date and acknowledgement timestamp are all captured.

generic.Defined scope/population: The approved endorsement changes to be entered on the policy in the administration system.
generic.In-scope period: From the approved endorsement effective date to the policy expiry date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Coverage, limits, deductibles, exposure values and transaction effective date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Recalculated policy premium matches the approved AP or RP figure exactly.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Committed transaction stored with user, timestamp and the approval reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Entry variances against the approval are logged and corrected before commit.
generic.Test population: All endorsement transactions entered in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the committed premium or effective date differs from the approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Variances stop the commit and return to the Underwriter for confirmation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the committed transaction matches the approval on terms, date and premium.
generic.Evidence location: Endorsement transaction in the policy administration system and Guidewire PolicyCenter.

steps.title: Enter revised coverage, limits and deductibles exactly as approved
sop: Open the endorsement transaction against the in-force term.
Enter the approved coverage, limits and deductibles.
Do not apply any change not present in the approval.
Done when entered terms match the approval line for line.
verify: Compare entered terms to the approval record.
Pass when no entered term differs from the approval.

steps.title: Enter the revised exposure values on the policy schedule
sop: Update values, payroll, revenue or unit counts as approved.
Reconcile the entered totals to the supplied schedule.
Correct any transcription difference.
Done when exposure values match the approved schedule.
verify: Recompute the schedule totals in the system.
Pass when system and schedule totals agree.

steps.title: Set the transaction effective date to the approved endorsement date
sop: Enter the approved endorsement effective date on the transaction.
Confirm it is not defaulted to today by the system.
Check the date against the approval record.
Done when the transaction carries the approved effective date.
verify: Compare the transaction effective date to the approval.
Pass when both dates match.

steps.title: Confirm the recalculated premium matches the approved AP or RP
sop: Run the premium recalculation on the transaction.
Compare the resulting AP or RP to the approved figure.
Investigate and resolve any difference before commit.
Done when the recalculated premium matches the approval.
verify: Recompute the difference between pre and post premium.
Pass when the recalculated AP or RP equals the approved figure.

steps.title: Re-check the forms schedule for added and removed endorsement forms
sop: Compare the forms schedule to the approved change set.
Add or remove forms so the schedule matches the approval.
Confirm each form version is currently filed.
Done when the forms schedule reflects the approved changes.
verify: Compare the schedule to the approved change set again.
Pass when the schedule and approval agree.

steps.title: Commit the transaction and confirm the post-change in-force position
sop: Commit the endorsement transaction in the policy system.
Resolve any validation errors raised on commit.
Read back the post-change in-force position on the policy.
Done when the transaction is committed and the policy reflects the change.
verify: Reopen the policy and read the committed transaction detail.
Pass when the transaction is committed with effective date and premium matching the approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: The policy of record and its downstream feeds after the endorsement is committed.
generic.In-scope period: Pre-endorsement period and post-endorsement period to policy expiry.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Transaction sequence, declarations version, effective dates and document links are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Downstream billing, reinsurance and warehouse records reconcile to the revised policy premium.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Both pre and post-endorsement policy versions retained with effective dating.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Downstream feeds that failed to update are logged with the resend outcome.
generic.Test population: All endorsements committed on the policy in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the pre-endorsement policy version is no longer retrievable.
generic.Exception handling path: Feed failures are re-triggered and escalated where they persist past the day.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when both versions are retrievable, declarations regenerate and feeds are updated.
generic.Evidence location: Policy transaction history in the policy administration system with documents in OpenText.

steps.title: Confirm the endorsement appears in the transaction history with a sequence number
sop: Open the policy transaction history after commit.
Confirm the endorsement is listed with its sequence number.
Check the sequence follows the prior transaction.
Done when the endorsement is visible and correctly sequenced.
verify: List the transaction sequence on the policy.
Pass when the sequence runs without gaps or duplicates.

steps.title: Regenerate the in-force declarations page with revised terms
sop: Trigger regeneration of the declarations page in the policy system.
Confirm the revised limits, deductibles and premium appear.
Confirm the form versions shown are filed.
Done when the declarations page reflects the revised terms.
verify: Compare the regenerated declarations to the committed transaction.
Pass when the declarations match the committed terms.

steps.title: Confirm the prior version remains retrievable for the pre-endorsement period
sop: Open the policy as at a date before the endorsement effective date.
Confirm the pre-endorsement terms display correctly.
Report any loss of the prior version immediately.
Done when the pre-endorsement version is retrievable.
verify: Retrieve both pre and post versions by effective date.
Pass when both pre and post-endorsement versions are retrievable.

steps.title: Verify downstream feeds picked up the revised record
sop: Check billing, reinsurance and data warehouse records for the revised premium.
Compare each to the committed policy premium.
Re-trigger any feed that did not update.
Done when all downstream records reflect the revision.
verify: Reconcile downstream premium figures to the policy premium.
Pass when every downstream record matches the policy.

steps.title: Attach the issued endorsement document to the policy record
sop: Index the issued endorsement document in OpenText.
Link it to the policy record and the transaction sequence.
Confirm the linked copy is the issued version.
Done when the issued document is attached to the policy record.
verify: Follow the policy record link to the document.
Pass when the linked document is the issued endorsement version.

steps.title: Log any feed failure and its resolution on the policy record
sop: Record any downstream feed that failed and the reason.
Record the resend and the confirmation of success.
Escalate failures still open at end of day.
Done when every feed exception carries a resolution.
verify: Filter the exception log for unresolved feed failures.
Pass when no feed failure is left without a resolution.

generic.Defined scope/population: Endorsement requests validated against in-force policy terms and underwriting authority.
generic.In-scope period: The in-force policy term covering the requested endorsement effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy status, wording permission, appetite position, producer check and outcome are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Validated request count reconciles to the logged endorsement request population.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation outcome recorded on the request with the validation date and validator.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected requests are logged with the rejection reason communicated to the broker.
generic.Test population: All endorsement requests reaching validation in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an endorsement is progressed against a cancelled or lapsed policy term.
generic.Exception handling path: Requests failing validation are rejected and returned to the broker with reasons.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when policy status, wording, appetite and producer checks all pass and are recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Validation record on the endorsement request in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Confirm the policy is in force at the requested effective date
sop: Open the policy in Guidewire PolicyCenter at the requested effective date.
Confirm status is in force and not cancelled or lapsed.
Reject and return the request where the policy is not in force.
Done when the in-force status at that date is confirmed.
verify: Re-read the policy status as at the requested effective date.
Pass when no endorsement is progressed against a cancelled or lapsed term.

steps.title: Check the change is permitted by the policy wording and filed forms
sop: Read the wording and filed forms covering the requested change.
Confirm the change can be made by endorsement on this product.
Identify the specific form needed to effect the change.
Done when the wording permission and required form are confirmed.
verify: Re-read the wording clause supporting the change.
Pass when the change is supported by the wording and a filed form.

steps.title: Confirm added exposure, location or class is inside current appetite
sop: Compare the added exposure to the current appetite guide.
Check the prohibited risk list for the added element.
Flag out-of-appetite additions for referral or rejection.
Done when the appetite position on the addition is confirmed.
verify: Re-check the addition against the appetite guide version.
Pass when out-of-appetite additions are flagged or rejected.

steps.title: Verify the requesting broker is the producer of record
sop: Read the appointed producer of record on the policy.
Compare it to the broker submitting the request.
Reject or query requests from an unappointed intermediary.
Done when the requesting broker is confirmed as producer of record.
verify: Compare the requesting broker code to the policy producer code.
Pass when the codes match or the discrepancy is resolved.

steps.title: Test the request against underwriting authority for the handler
sop: Estimate the post-change premium and limit position.
Compare it to the handling underwriter authority band.
Mark the request for referral where authority is exceeded.
Done when the authority position on the request is determined.
verify: Re-test the estimated post-change figures against the matrix.
Pass when over-authority requests are marked for referral.

steps.title: Record the validation outcome and any rejection reason
sop: Record pass or reject on the endorsement request.
State the rejection reason where the request fails validation.
Communicate the outcome to the broker.
Done when the validation outcome is recorded and communicated.
verify: Open the request and read the validation fields.
Pass when the outcome and any rejection reason are both recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Underwriting files for policies cancelled or non-renewed and ready for archive.
generic.In-scope period: From the cancellation or non-renewal effective date to the archive completion date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, insured name, cancellation date and archive reference are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived document count reconciles to the file index for the policy.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archive bundle stored in OpenText with archive date and immutable version markers.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Files archived with open premium or claim items are logged and reopened.
generic.Test population: All cancelled or non-renewed policies archived in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the notice copy or proof of delivery is missing from the archived bundle.
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete bundles return to the assistant for completion before archive closure.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when a complete, indexed, locked and retrievable bundle exists with no open items.
generic.Evidence location: OpenText archive bundle referenced from the closed policy record.

steps.title: Assemble the archive bundle in OpenText Document Mgmt
sop: Collect the underwriting file, notice copy and proof of delivery.
Add correspondence and the final policy documents.
Compile them into a single archive bundle.
Done when the bundle contains all required components.
verify: Check the bundle for the notice copy and proof of delivery.
Pass when both are present in the archived bundle.

steps.title: Index the archive by policy number, insured name and closure date
sop: Apply the index metadata to the bundle in OpenText.
Include the cancellation or non-renewal effective date.
Confirm the index values match the policy record.
Done when the bundle is fully indexed.
verify: Search OpenText by policy number and by insured name.
Pass when the bundle is found by both index keys.

steps.title: Confirm no open premium or claim item remains
sop: Check billing for outstanding premium or unpaid refunds.
Check the claims system for open claims on the policy.
Hold the archive where any item remains open.
Done when no open premium or claim item remains.
verify: Re-run the open item checks on the policy.
Pass when billing and claims both show no open items.

steps.title: Lock the archived file against further edits
sop: Apply the archive lock to the bundle in OpenText.
Confirm the content can still be read after locking.
Record who applied the lock and when.
Done when the bundle is locked but readable.
verify: Attempt an edit on the locked bundle.
Pass when the bundle is uneditable yet still retrievable.

steps.title: Record the archive reference on the closed policy record
sop: Write the OpenText archive reference to the policy record.
Confirm the link resolves from the policy administration system.
Note the archive date on the policy.
Done when the archive reference is on the policy record.
verify: Follow the archive link from the policy record.
Pass when the link opens the archived bundle.

steps.title: Confirm the archived bundle is retrievable end to end
sop: Retrieve the bundle from a clean search using the index keys.
Open the notice copy and proof of delivery from within it.
Record the retrieval test result.
Done when a successful retrieval test is recorded.
verify: Repeat the retrieval using the insured name key.
Pass when the complete bundle including notice and proof retrieves successfully.

generic.Defined scope/population: The return premium due to the insured on the cancelled policy term.
generic.In-scope period: From the cancellation effective date to the original policy expiry date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Calculation basis, unearned days, minimum earned premium and net refund are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Refund plus earned premium reconciles to the total term premium charged.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Calculation stored on the cancellation transaction with the calculation date and basis.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Refunds netted against receivables are logged with the offset detail.
generic.Test population: All cancellations with a return premium calculated in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the calculation does not show the short-rate or pro-rata basis and the unearned day count.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed calculations route to the Policy Administration Analyst for recalculation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the basis matches the cancelling party and the refund is netted and disclosed.
generic.Evidence location: Return premium calculation in Guidewire BillingCenter linked to the policy transaction.

steps.title: Determine short-rate or pro-rata basis from who initiated cancellation
sop: Read the cancellation reason and the initiating party.
Select short-rate for insured-initiated where the wording requires it.
Select pro-rata for insurer-initiated cancellations.
Done when the correct calculation basis is selected.
verify: Re-read the wording rule for the cancellation type.
Pass when the selected basis matches the initiating party rule.

steps.title: Calculate unearned premium from effective date to original expiry
sop: Count the days from cancellation effective date to original expiry.
Apply the selected basis to the term premium.
Record the unearned premium and the day count.
Done when the unearned premium is calculated with a day count.
verify: Recompute the day count and unearned amount.
Pass when the recalculation matches the recorded figures.

steps.title: Deduct non-refundable minimum earned premium and fees
sop: Read the minimum earned premium and fee terms in the wording.
Deduct any non-refundable amounts from the unearned figure.
Record each deduction and its wording basis.
Done when all non-refundable amounts are deducted.
verify: Re-read the wording clauses for each deduction.
Pass when every deduction is supported by the wording.

steps.title: Net the refund against outstanding premium receivable in BillingCenter
sop: Check the billing account for outstanding premium receivable.
Offset the refund against any balance owed.
Record the net refund payable to the insured.
Done when the refund is netted against receivables.
verify: Recompute the net position from refund and receivable balances.
Pass when the net refund matches the recalculation.

steps.title: Post the return premium transaction to the policy
sop: Post the return premium against the cancelled term in the policy system.
Confirm the posting date and the transaction reference.
Confirm the posting reaches billing for payment.
Done when the return premium is posted and visible in billing.
verify: Compare the posted amount to the calculated net refund.
Pass when the posting matches the calculation.

steps.title: Show the refund amount and basis on the cancellation notice
sop: Include the refund amount and calculation basis on the notice to the insured.
State the unearned day count used.
Confirm the notice figures match the posted transaction.
Done when the notice discloses the refund and its basis.
verify: Read the issued notice for the refund disclosure.
Pass when the return premium is shown with basis and unearned day count.

generic.Defined scope/population: The policy record being closed on cancellation across coverages and downstream systems.
generic.In-scope period: From the cancellation effective date onward for the remainder of the term.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Status, cancellation effective date, reason code and return premium posting are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Closed policy premium reconciles to earned premium plus the posted return premium.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Closure transaction committed with user, timestamp and reason code.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Coverages still active after the effective date are logged and closed.
generic.Test population: All policies closed on cancellation in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the reason code recorded differs from the reason on the served notice.
generic.Exception handling path: Reason code mismatches return to the analyst for correction before closure.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when status, date and reason match the notice and downstream systems are updated.
generic.Evidence location: Cancellation transaction in the policy administration system and Guidewire PolicyCenter.

steps.title: Set the policy status to cancelled with the correct effective date
sop: Open the cancellation transaction on the in-force term.
Set status to cancelled with the approved effective date.
Confirm the date is not defaulted to the processing date.
Done when the cancelled status carries the correct effective date.
verify: Compare the transaction date to the approved cancellation date.
Pass when both dates match.

steps.title: Record the cancellation reason code matching the served notice
sop: Read the reason stated on the notice actually served.
Select the matching reason code in the policy system.
Correct any mismatch before committing.
Done when the reason code matches the served notice.
verify: Compare the recorded code to the notice reason text.
Pass when the code and the served notice reason are consistent.

steps.title: Check no coverage remains active after the effective date
sop: Review every location, coverage and sub-policy on the term.
Confirm each terminates at the cancellation effective date.
Close any coverage still showing as active.
Done when no coverage remains active beyond the effective date.
verify: Re-run the active coverage check as at the day after cancellation.
Pass when no active coverage is returned.

steps.title: Confirm the return premium transaction is posted before closure
sop: Check the return premium posting exists on the term.
Compare the amount to the approved calculation.
Hold closure where the posting is missing.
Done when the return premium is posted.
verify: Compare posted return premium to the calculation.
Pass when the posting matches the calculated refund.

steps.title: Commit the closure in Guidewire PolicyCenter
sop: Commit the cancellation transaction.
Resolve validation errors raised on commit.
Read back the closed status on the policy.
Done when the closure transaction is committed.
verify: Reopen the policy and read status and effective date.
Pass when the policy shows cancelled with the correct effective date.

steps.title: Verify the closure flows to billing, reinsurance and the warehouse
sop: Check billing, reinsurance and warehouse records for the cancelled status.
Re-trigger any feed that did not update.
Log any feed exception and its resolution.
Done when all downstream systems show the cancellation.
verify: Reconcile downstream status and dates to the policy record.
Pass when cancellation status, effective date and reason code are consistent everywhere.

generic.Defined scope/population: The stated grounds for non-renewal or cancellation on the affected policy.
generic.In-scope period: The expiring policy term and the notice window before its expiry date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Ground code, evidence reference, state and line, and confirming underwriter are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Confirmed grounds reconcile to the non-renewal candidate list for the cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Ground confirmation recorded with date and the evidence document reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Policies within guaranteed renewability or moratorium are logged and removed from the list.
generic.Test population: All policies proposed for non-renewal or cancellation in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the ground is asserted without an evidence reference in the file.
generic.Exception handling path: Prohibited or unevidenced grounds stop the process and the policy renews instead.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when a permitted ground is confirmed, evidenced and recorded before notice generation.
generic.Evidence location: Non-renewal ground record on the policy in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Identify the permitted grounds for the line and state
sop: Read the permitted non-renewal grounds for the line and governing state.
Select the ground that matches the underwriting position.
Record the ground code on the policy.
Done when a permitted ground is selected and recorded.
verify: Re-check the selected ground against the permitted list.
Pass when the recorded ground is on the permitted list for the line and state.

steps.title: Check the policy is not within guaranteed renewability or continuation
sop: Read the wording for guaranteed renewability provisions.
Check for any statutory continuation period in force.
Remove the policy from the list where either applies.
Done when renewability restrictions are checked and applied.
verify: Re-read the wording and statutory position.
Pass when no restricted policy remains on the non-renewal list.

steps.title: Evidence the ground with loss runs, survey or appetite decision
sop: Attach loss runs, survey findings or the appetite exit memo to the file.
Link each evidence item to the stated ground.
Reject grounds that rest on assertion alone.
Done when the ground is supported by filed evidence.
verify: Open the linked evidence from the ground record.
Pass when every ground resolves to a filed evidence document.

steps.title: Test the ground against prohibited bases
sop: Check the ground is not a protected characteristic or other prohibited basis.
Check restrictions on single weather claims where they apply.
Escalate any doubtful ground before proceeding.
Done when the ground is confirmed not prohibited.
verify: Re-check the ground against the prohibited basis list.
Pass when no prohibited basis is used as a ground.

steps.title: Record the confirmed ground and the confirming underwriter
sop: Write the confirmed ground, evidence reference and confirmation date.
Name the underwriter who confirmed the ground.
Lock the record before notice generation.
Done when the ground record is complete and locked.
verify: Read back the ground record fields.
Pass when the permitted ground is recorded with a supporting evidence reference.

steps.title: Obtain management confirmation before notice generation
sop: Review the ground, evidence and restriction checks.
Confirm or reject the non-renewal on that ground.
Record the decision and date on the policy.
Done when management confirmation is recorded.
verify: Compare the confirmation date to the notice generation date.
Pass when no notice was generated before the ground was confirmed.

generic.Defined scope/population: Retention settings applied to archived cancelled and non-renewed policy files.
generic.In-scope period: From the retention trigger date to the calculated destruction date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Retention rule reference, start date, period and destruction date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived files with retention set reconcile to the archived file count for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Retention metadata stored on the archived record with the rule version applied.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Files under legal hold are logged with the hold reference overriding destruction.
generic.Test population: All files archived in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the destruction date is earlier than the longest applicable required period.
generic.Exception handling path: Short or missing retention settings return to the assistant for correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when rule, start date and destruction date are populated and holds are respected.
generic.Evidence location: Retention metadata on the OpenText archived record linked from the policy system.

steps.title: Confirm the retention clock start trigger date
sop: Identify whether the trigger is policy expiry or cancellation effective date.
Read the actual date from the policy administration system.
Record the trigger date on the archived record.
Done when the correct trigger date is recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded trigger to the policy closure record.
Pass when the trigger date matches the policy record.

steps.title: Determine the longest applicable retention period
sop: Read the state, line-of-business and sanctions recordkeeping requirements.
Select the longest of the applicable periods.
Record the rule reference behind the selection.
Done when the longest applicable period is selected.
verify: Re-check each requirement source against the selection.
Pass when the applied period is the longest of the applicable requirements.

steps.title: Apply the retention rule to the archived record in OpenText
sop: Set the retention rule and period on the archived bundle.
Confirm the system calculates a destruction date.
Record the rule version applied.
Done when the retention rule is applied in OpenText.
verify: Read the retention metadata on the archived record.
Pass when rule, start date and destruction date are all populated.

steps.title: Check the calculated destruction date is not too early
sop: Recompute the destruction date from trigger plus period.
Compare it to the system calculated date.
Correct the setting where the date is too early.
Done when the destruction date meets or exceeds the requirement.
verify: Recompute the required earliest destruction date.
Pass when the recorded date is not earlier than the requirement.

steps.title: Apply any legal hold overriding the destruction date
sop: Check the account for an active legal hold or litigation flag.
Apply the hold in OpenText so destruction is suspended.
Record the hold reference and owner.
Done when active holds are applied to the record.
verify: Test the record against the destruction schedule with the hold applied.
Pass when held records are excluded from scheduled destruction.

steps.title: Record the applied retention rule reference against the archived file
sop: Write the rule reference and applied period to the archived record.
Link the retention setting to the policy record.
Confirm the setting is visible from both systems.
Done when the retention reference is recorded and linked.
verify: Open the archived record from the policy system.
Pass when the retention rule, start date and destruction date are visible.

generic.Defined scope/population: Statutory notice requirements for the policies being non-renewed or cancelled.
generic.In-scope period: The notice window ending at the policy expiry or cancellation effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Governing state, line, reason, required notice days and latest mailing date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Policies with a calculated mailing date reconcile to the non-renewal candidate list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notice period determination recorded with the rule source and determination date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Policies whose mailing date has passed are logged and allowed to renew.
generic.Test population: All policies scheduled for non-renewal or cancellation in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the notice days or the latest mailing date is missing for any policy.
generic.Exception handling path: Passed mailing dates escalate immediately so the policy renews rather than lapses in error.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the longer of statutory and contractual periods is applied and diarised.
generic.Evidence location: Notice period record on the policy in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Identify the governing state and line of business for the policy
sop: Read the risk location and policy state from the policy system.
Identify the line of business and product code.
Record both on the notice determination.
Done when the governing state and line are recorded.
verify: Compare the recorded state and line to the policy record.
Pass when both match the policy record.

steps.title: Look up required advance notice days for state, line and reason
sop: Consult the notice period reference for the state, line and reason.
Record the required advance notice days.
Note the rule source and its version.
Done when the statutory notice days are recorded with a source.
verify: Re-check the notice days against the rule source.
Pass when the recorded days match the current rule.

steps.title: Apply the longer of the statutory and contractual notice periods
sop: Read any longer notice period stated in the policy wording.
Compare it to the statutory requirement.
Apply the longer of the two.
Done when the applied period is the longer of the two.
verify: Re-read the wording notice clause and compare.
Pass when the longer period is the one applied.

steps.title: Calculate the latest permissible mailing date
sop: Count back the applied notice days from the expiry or effective date.
Allow for any mailing or delivery transit requirement.
Record the latest permissible mailing date.
Done when the latest mailing date is calculated.
verify: Recompute the mailing date from expiry and notice days.
Pass when the recorded mailing date matches the recalculation.

steps.title: Diarise the mailing date against the expiry date in the workstation
sop: Create the diary entry for the latest mailing date.
Set an earlier warning ahead of the deadline.
Assign the diary to the handling underwriter.
Done when the mailing deadline is diarised and assigned.
verify: Open the diary and confirm the entry and owner.
Pass when every candidate policy has a diarised mailing deadline.

steps.title: Escalate policies whose mailing date has already passed
sop: Identify candidates where the latest mailing date has passed.
Escalate immediately so the policy renews rather than lapses.
Record the decision to renew and the reason.
Done when every passed-deadline policy carries a renewal decision.
verify: Re-run the passed-deadline filter after escalation.
Pass when no passed-deadline policy is progressed to non-renewal.

generic.Defined scope/population: Non-renewal notices to be dispatched to the named insured and producing broker.
generic.In-scope period: On or before the latest permissible mailing date for each policy.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Recipient address, dispatch date, delivery method and proof reference are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Dispatched notice count reconciles to the confirmed non-renewal candidate list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Dated proof of mailing or delivery retained in the policy file.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Undeliverable notices are logged with the re-dispatch action and date.
generic.Test population: All non-renewal notices dispatched in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if dispatch occurred after the statutory deadline or proof of mailing is missing.
generic.Exception handling path: Late or failed dispatches escalate to the Renewal Underwriter and the policy renews if out of time.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the notice is dispatched in time by the required method with retained proof.
generic.Evidence location: Proof of mailing in OpenText linked to the policy record and the broker portal record.

steps.title: Confirm the dispatch date against the latest permissible mailing date
sop: Read the calculated latest mailing date for the policy.
Confirm the planned dispatch is on or before that date.
Escalate where the date cannot be met.
Done when dispatch timing is confirmed inside the deadline.
verify: Compare the actual dispatch date to the deadline.
Pass when dispatch occurred on or before the statutory deadline.

steps.title: Address the notice to the named insured at the last known address
sop: Read the named insured mailing address from the policy system.
Confirm no more recent address is held on file.
Address the notice to that address.
Done when the notice is addressed to the last known address.
verify: Compare the notice address to the policy record address.
Pass when both addresses match.

steps.title: Copy the producing broker through the Broker & Agent Portal
sop: Send the notice copy to the producing broker via the portal.
Confirm the broker record is the current producer of record.
Log the broker copy date.
Done when the producing broker has been copied.
verify: Open the portal record for the broker copy.
Pass when the broker copy is logged with a date.

steps.title: Use the statutorily required delivery method
sop: Read the required delivery method for the state and reason.
Dispatch by certificate of mailing or tracked delivery where mandated.
Record the method used on the policy.
Done when the required delivery method is used and recorded.
verify: Compare the method used to the state requirement.
Pass when the mandated method was used.

steps.title: Retain the dated proof of mailing in the policy file
sop: Obtain the certificate of mailing or delivery confirmation.
Index it in OpenText against the policy and notice.
Link the proof to the policy record.
Done when dated proof of mailing is filed and linked.
verify: Follow the policy link to the proof document.
Pass when a dated proof of mailing is retained and retrievable.

steps.title: Include the adverse action notice where a consumer report was used
sop: Check whether the decision relied on a consumer report.
Include the adverse action wording and required disclosures where it did.
Record the inclusion on the dispatch record.
Done when adverse action wording is included where required.
verify: Compare the dispatched notice content to the consumer report usage flag.
Pass when every report-based decision carries the adverse action notice.

generic.Defined scope/population: The recorded non-renewal rationale for each policy where notice was served.
generic.In-scope period: From the non-renewal decision to the serving of the notice.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reason text, guideline reference, evidence link, approver and date are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Rationale records reconcile to the served notice register for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: File note stored in the workstation and OpenText with author and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Conflicts between file reason and served notice are logged and reconciled.
generic.Test population: All policies with a non-renewal notice served in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the documented reason conflicts with the reason on the served notice.
generic.Exception handling path: Conflicting or vague rationales return to the underwriter before the file is closed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the reason matches the notice, cites a guideline and names the approver.
generic.Evidence location: Non-renewal rationale note in the underwriting workstation indexed in OpenText.

steps.title: State the specific non-renewal reason in the underwriting file
sop: Write the reason in language consistent with the notice to the insured.
Avoid generic phrases that would not stand up to examination.
Record the reason against the policy and term.
Done when a specific reason is recorded in the file.
verify: Compare the file reason to the reason text on the served notice.
Pass when the two do not conflict.

steps.title: Reference the underwriting guideline or appetite decision
sop: Cite the guideline clause or appetite exit memo supporting the reason.
Record the guideline version and date.
Confirm the guideline was in force at the decision date.
Done when the supporting guideline is cited.
verify: Open the cited guideline and check its effective date.
Pass when the guideline cited was in force at the decision.

steps.title: Attach supporting evidence to the file note
sop: Attach loss runs, survey report or appetite exit memo as applicable.
Link each evidence item to the stated reason.
Index the evidence bundle in OpenText.
Done when the reason is fully evidenced in the file.
verify: Open each attachment from the note.
Pass when every evidence link resolves to a filed document.

steps.title: Reconcile the file rationale against the served notice
sop: Read the served notice and the file rationale side by side.
Identify any conflict in reason or wording.
Correct the file or reissue the notice as appropriate.
Done when file and notice reasons are consistent.
verify: Re-read both documents after correction.
Pass when the file rationale and the served notice agree.

steps.title: Record the approving underwriter and decision date
sop: Name the underwriter who approved the non-renewal.
Record the approval date on the rationale note.
Confirm the approver held the required authority.
Done when approver and date are recorded.
verify: Compare the approver band to the account size and decision type.
Pass when the approver held sufficient authority.

steps.title: Index the rationale note in OpenText for regulatory inspection
sop: Index the note and evidence against policy number and notice date.
Confirm retrieval by policy number works.
Lock the note against later edit.
Done when the note is indexed, retrievable and locked.
verify: Retrieve the note by policy number from OpenText.
Pass when a documented reason matching the notice with guideline reference and approver retrieves.

generic.Defined scope/population: Non-renewal notices generated for policies confirmed for non-renewal.
generic.In-scope period: From ground confirmation to dispatch within the statutory notice window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, insured name, address, expiry date, reason and required statements are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Generated notice count reconciles to the confirmed non-renewal candidate list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Generated notice stored with template version, generation date and generating user.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Notices generated on the wrong template are logged and regenerated.
generic.Test population: All non-renewal notices generated in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the notice uses a template that is not the state-approved version for the line.
generic.Exception handling path: Template or content defects stop dispatch until the notice is regenerated.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when a state-approved template carries the specific reason and required statements.
generic.Evidence location: Generated notice in the policy administration system indexed in OpenText.

steps.title: Select the state-approved non-renewal template for the line
sop: Read the governing state and line of business for the policy.
Select the approved notice template for that combination.
Record the template version used.
Done when the correct approved template is selected.
verify: Compare the template version to the approved template register.
Pass when a state-approved template version is used.

steps.title: Populate the specific reason for non-renewal
sop: Insert the confirmed reason from the ground record.
Avoid generic or catch-all phrasing.
Confirm the wording is consistent with the underwriting file.
Done when the specific reason appears on the notice.
verify: Compare the notice reason to the confirmed ground record.
Pass when the notice states the specific confirmed reason.

steps.title: Verify policy number, insured, address and expiry date on the notice
sop: Cross-check each field against the policy administration record.
Correct any mismatch before the notice is finalised.
Confirm the expiry date shown is the actual policy expiry.
Done when all identity fields are verified correct.
verify: Re-compare the four fields to the policy record.
Pass when all four fields match the policy record.

steps.title: Include the required statutory statements
sop: Include the effective date of non-renewal on the notice.
Include the right to request further information.
Include any market-of-last-resort referral wording required.
Done when all required statements appear on the notice.
verify: Check the notice against the required statement list for the state.
Pass when every required statement is present.

steps.title: Attach adverse action wording where consumer data was used
sop: Check whether the decision relied on credit or consumer report data.
Attach the adverse action wording and disclosures where it did.
Record the inclusion on the notice record.
Done when adverse action wording is attached where required.
verify: Compare the notice to the consumer report usage flag.
Pass when report-based decisions carry the adverse action wording.

steps.title: Index the generated notice in OpenText ready for dispatch
sop: Index the notice against policy number and generation date.
Link it to the policy record for the dispatch step.
Set the notice status to ready for dispatch.
Done when the notice is indexed and ready for dispatch.
verify: Retrieve the notice from the policy record.
Pass when the state-approved notice with reason and required statements retrieves.

generic.Defined scope/population: In-force policies screened as candidates for non-renewal in the coming cycle.
generic.In-scope period: Policies expiring far enough ahead to serve the longest applicable notice period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Selection criterion, days to expiry, class and geography flags are populated per candidate.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Candidate count and premium reconcile to the renewal book listing for the window.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Candidate list saved with run date, criteria version and director sign-off date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Policies removed for renewability restrictions are logged with the restriction reference.
generic.Test population: All in-force policies expiring in the screening window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any candidate lacks a stated selection criterion or a days-to-expiry value.
generic.Exception handling path: Concentration or restriction findings return to the Portfolio UW Manager before sign-off.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when criteria-based candidates are screened in time and signed off by the director.
generic.Evidence location: Non-renewal candidate list in Power BI with the flags recorded in the underwriting workstation.

steps.title: Select candidates on loss ratio, appetite and risk-quality criteria in Power BI
sop: Apply the selection criteria stated in the approved renewal strategy.
Produce the candidate list with the driving criterion per policy.
Record the run date and criteria version.
Done when candidates are selected by documented criteria.
verify: Filter the candidate list for blank selection criteria.
Pass when every candidate shows its selection criterion.

steps.title: Screen candidates against the longest applicable notice period
sop: Calculate days to expiry for each candidate.
Compare against the longest notice period applicable by state and line.
Remove candidates already inside the notice deadline.
Done when every candidate has enough lead time or is removed.
verify: Recompute days to expiry for the shortest-dated candidates.
Pass when selection criteria and days to expiry are shown for every candidate.

steps.title: Remove policies where non-renewal is restricted
sop: Check for guaranteed renewability, statutory moratorium or emergency orders.
Remove affected policies from the candidate list.
Log the restriction reference for each removal.
Done when restricted policies are removed and logged.
verify: Re-run the restriction checks over the remaining list.
Pass when no restricted policy remains a candidate.

steps.title: Test the list for class and geography concentration effects
sop: Group candidates by class and by geography.
Flag where a single class or region is being exited en masse.
Raise the finding for management consideration.
Done when concentration effects are identified and flagged.
verify: Recompute the class and geography shares of the candidate list.
Pass when any mass-exit concentration is flagged.

steps.title: Record the candidate flags in the underwriting workstation
sop: Write the non-renewal candidate flag to each policy record.
Record the criterion and days to expiry on the flag.
Link the flag to the Power BI candidate run.
Done when every candidate is flagged in the workstation.
verify: Reconcile flagged policies to the Power BI candidate count.
Pass when both counts agree.

steps.title: Obtain director sign-off before notices are generated
sop: Review criteria, restrictions and concentration findings.
Approve or amend the candidate list.
Record the sign-off name and date on the list.
Done when the list carries director sign-off.
verify: Compare the sign-off date to the first notice generation date.
Pass when no notice was generated before sign-off.

generic.Defined scope/population: Billing, reinsurance accounting and claims teams needing the cancellation effective date.
generic.In-scope period: From the cancellation effective date to the end of the current accounting period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy number, cancellation effective date, reason and recipient team are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Notified cancellations reconcile to cancellations processed in the policy system.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notifications and acknowledgements logged on the policy with dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unacknowledged notifications are logged and re-sent with the chase date.
generic.Test population: All cancellations processed in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if premium billing remains scheduled for periods after the cancellation effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Downstream teams that do not act are escalated by the Policy Administration Analyst.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when all three teams are notified with the exact date and acknowledgements are logged.
generic.Evidence location: Notification log on the policy record with the Teams or email trail and BillingCenter status.

steps.title: Notify billing to stop premium and schedule the return premium
sop: Send the cancellation advice to billing with the effective date and reason.
Request premium billing stops from that date.
Request the return premium is scheduled.
Done when billing has the cancellation advice.
verify: Check Guidewire BillingCenter for scheduled premium after the effective date.
Pass when no premium billing is scheduled after the cancellation effective date.

steps.title: Notify reinsurance accounting for the correct accounting period
sop: Advise reinsurance accounting of the cancellation and ceded impact.
State the accounting period in which the adjustment belongs.
Send through Microsoft Teams or email with the policy reference.
Done when reinsurance accounting has the advice.
verify: Confirm the cession adjustment appears in Sapiens ReinsurancePro.
Pass when the adjustment is booked to the correct period.

steps.title: Notify claims so no new claim is set up after the effective date
sop: Advise the claims team of the cancellation effective date.
Confirm coverage validation will reject post-cancellation claims.
Record the claims notification on the policy.
Done when claims has the cancellation advice.
verify: Check the policy coverage status visible to claims.
Pass when claims sees the policy as cancelled from the effective date.

steps.title: State the exact effective date and reason in every notification
sop: Use the same effective date and reason text across all notifications.
Avoid restating the reason differently for different teams.
Attach the cancellation transaction reference.
Done when all notifications carry identical date and reason.
verify: Compare the three notifications side by side.
Pass when date and reason are identical across all three.

steps.title: Collect acknowledgements from each team
sop: Request explicit acknowledgement from billing, reinsurance and claims.
Chase any team that has not acknowledged within the standard.
Record each acknowledgement date and person.
Done when all three acknowledgements are received.
verify: Count acknowledgements against notifications sent.
Pass when every notification has an acknowledgement.

steps.title: Log the notifications and acknowledgements on the policy record
sop: Write each notification date, recipient and acknowledgement to the policy.
Attach the message trail to the policy record.
Escalate any outstanding acknowledgement.
Done when the notification log is complete on the policy.
verify: Open the policy record and read the notification log.
Pass when all three notifications and their acknowledgements are logged.

generic.Defined scope/population: Mid-term cancellation requests received from insureds or brokers on in-force policies.
generic.In-scope period: From request receipt to the requested cancellation effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Signed request, requester authority, requested effective date and interested parties are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Processed cancellations reconcile to the signed request register for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed request indexed in OpenText with receipt date and requester identity.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Requests without authority or signature are logged and returned to the requester.
generic.Test population: All mid-term cancellation requests received in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the effective date used in the system differs from the signed request.
generic.Exception handling path: Backdating or authority failures route to the Underwriter before any processing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when a signed, authorised request is processed on the permitted effective date.
generic.Evidence location: Signed cancellation request in OpenText linked to the policy transaction.

steps.title: Obtain the signed cancellation request with the requested effective date
sop: Collect the signed request from the insured or broker.
Confirm the requested effective date is stated clearly.
Index the request in OpenText against the policy.
Done when a signed request with an effective date is on file.
verify: Compare the filed request date to the system effective date.
Pass when the signed request effective date is the date used.

steps.title: Confirm the requester has authority to cancel
sop: Check the signatory is the named insured or the appointed broker.
Where broker-initiated, confirm a lost-policy release or written authority.
Reject requests from unauthorised parties.
Done when requester authority is confirmed.
verify: Compare the signatory to the named insured and producer record.
Pass when the requester is authorised to cancel.

steps.title: Check for a statutory cooling-off period entitlement
sop: Compare the request date to the policy inception date.
Determine whether a cooling-off right gives a full premium refund.
Record the cooling-off determination on the request.
Done when the cooling-off position is determined.
verify: Recompute the days from inception to the request.
Pass when cooling-off entitlement is correctly applied or excluded.

steps.title: Test the effective date against permitted backdating rules
sop: Read the wording and state rules on backdated cancellations.
Compare the requested date to the permitted window.
Reject or adjust dates outside the permitted window.
Done when the effective date is confirmed permissible.
verify: Re-check the effective date against the backdating rule.
Pass when no cancellation is backdated beyond the permitted window.

steps.title: Check for premium finance, mortgagee or loss payee interests
sop: Read the policy for premium finance, mortgagee or loss payee interests.
Serve any notice required to those parties before cancelling.
Record the notices served and their dates.
Done when all interested parties have been notified as required.
verify: Compare notices served to the interested party list on the policy.
Pass when every interested party requiring notice received it.

steps.title: Process the cancellation in the policy administration system
sop: Enter the cancellation with the confirmed effective date and reason.
Link the signed request to the transaction.
Commit the transaction and confirm the status.
Done when the cancellation is processed and linked to the request.
verify: Open the transaction and follow the link to the signed request.
Pass when a signed request is on file with the effective date used in the system.

generic.Defined scope/population: Reinstatement terms to be applied to the lapsed policy on restoration.
generic.In-scope period: From the reinstatement effective date to the original policy expiry date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Revised rating, deductible, exclusions, gap treatment and reinstatement forms are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Recalculated premium for the remaining term reconciles to the approved reinstatement terms.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Applied terms stored on the reinstatement transaction with the approval reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unapproved concessions are logged and removed before the transaction commits.
generic.Test population: All reinstatement transactions processed in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if applied terms differ from what the underwriter approved.
generic.Exception handling path: Differences from the approval stop the transaction and return to the Underwriter.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when approved terms, gap treatment and recalculated premium are all applied.
generic.Evidence location: Reinstatement transaction in the policy administration system and Guidewire PolicyCenter.

steps.title: Apply the revised rating, deductible or exclusion conditions
sop: Read the reinstatement conditions from the underwriting approval.
Apply each revised rating factor, deductible or exclusion.
Do not apply conditions absent from the approval.
Done when all approved conditions are applied.
verify: Compare applied conditions to the approval record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Reinstatement confirmations issued to the insured and the producing broker.
